words.en: Wholesale is the business of buying and selling goods in large quantities, especially for resale to retailers.

words.ex: I found a great bargain at the market.
words.ex_cn: 我在市场上找到了一件便宜货。
words.en: A bargain is an agreement between two people or groups in which each promises to do something in exchange for something else. It can also refer to something bought or offered for sale much more cheaply than is usual or expected.

words.tr:
n. 折扣；
v. 不全信；不重视；
words.ex: The store gave a 20% discount on all shoes.
words.ex_cn: 商店对所有鞋子提供了20%的折扣。
words.en: A reduction in the usual price of something, or the act of reducing the price.

words.ex: He bought a concession ticket for the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他买了电影的减价票。
words.en: A concession is a point or principle that is granted or acknowledged in the course of an argument or negotiation, often as a compromise or to facilitate agreement.

words.tr:
n. 折扣；退款
v. 减少
words.ex: He got a rebate on his new TV.
words.ex_cn: 他买新电视时得到了一笔回扣。
words.en: A rebate is a partial refund to someone who has paid too much for tax, rent, or a utility.

words.ex: He kept the receipt for his new shoes.
words.ex_cn: 他保留了新鞋的收据。
words.en: A receipt is a piece of paper that you get from someone as proof that they have received money or goods from you.

words.tr:
n. 发票；发货单；
v. 开发票；记清单；
words.ex: He paid the bill after receiving the invoice.
words.ex_cn: 他收到发票后付了款。
words.en: An invoice is a document that lists goods or services that have been provided and says how much money you owe for them.

words.ex: The price tag on the shirt is $20.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫的价格标签是20美元。
words.en: A label attached to an item displaying its cost.

words.tr:
n. 标签；
v. 用标签标明；
words.ex: The bottle has a label with the name of the drink.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子上有一个写着饮料名称的标签。
words.en: A label is a piece of paper, polymer, cloth, metal, or other material affixed to a container or article, on which is written or printed information or symbols about the product or item.

words.ex: The sale price of the shirt is $10.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫的促销价是10美元。
words.en: The price at which something is offered for sale.

words.ex: The new policy is for the promotion of clean energy.
words.ex_cn: 这项新政策是为了促进清洁能源。
words.en: A promotion is a move to a more important job or rank in a company or organization.

words.ex: He wrote an article about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于气候变化的文章。
words.en: An article is a piece of writing on a particular subject in a newspaper, magazine, or online. It can also refer to a particular item or object, or a clause in a legal document.

words.tr: n. 一件物品或商品；项目；一则；
words.ex: This item is on sale for $5.
words.ex_cn: 这件商品正在促销，售价5美元。
words.en: An item is one of a collection or list of objects.

words.tr:
n. 展示；陈列；
v. 展示；陈列；
words.ex: The store has a big display of new phones.
words.ex_cn: 商店里有一个新手机的展示。
words.en: To display something means to put it in a place where people can see it easily, or to show it to people.

words.ex: He enjoys window-shopping on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末逛橱窗。
words.en: The activity of looking at goods displayed in shop windows, especially without intending to buy anything.

words.ex: I bought milk at the convenience store.
words.ex_cn: 我在便利店买了牛奶。
words.en: A convenience store is a small retail business that stocks a range of everyday items such as groceries, snack foods, confectionery, soft drinks, tobacco products, and may also offer money order and wire transfer services. These stores are known for their extended operating hours and convenient locations.

words.ex: She bought a dress from a small boutique downtown.
words.ex_cn: 她在市中心的一家小型时装精品屋买了一条裙子。
words.en: A boutique is a small shop that sells stylish clothes, shoes, or jewelry.

words.ex: He buys milk and bread at the grocery.
words.ex_cn: 他在杂货店买牛奶和面包。
words.en: A grocery is a store where food and small items for the house are sold.

words.ex: He buys milk and bread from the grocer.
words.ex_cn: 他从杂货店买牛奶和面包。
words.en: A grocer is a person who sells food and small household goods.

words.tr: phrase. 蔬菜水果商；专售新鲜蔬菜和水果的商店
words.ex: He buys fresh vegetables from the green grocer every Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 他每个星期六从蔬果店买新鲜蔬菜。
words.en: A greengrocer is a shopkeeper who sells fruit and vegetables.

words.ex: I bought a newspaper at the newsagent's paper shop.
words.ex_cn: 我在报刊店买了一份报纸。
words.en: A shop that sells newspapers, magazines, and often stationery.

words.tr: n. 清单；检查表；备忘录；目录册；
words.ex: He made a checklist for his trip.
words.ex_cn: 他为旅行列了一份清单。
words.en: A checklist is a list of items required, things to be done, or points to be considered, used as a reminder.

words.ex: He wrote down the booklist for his class.
words.ex_cn: 他把课程的书单写了下来。
words.en: A list of books, especially one that is recommended or required for a particular course of study.

words.tr: n. 活页练习题；工作记录；工作表
words.ex: The teacher gave the students a worksheet for homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师给学生们发了一份练习表作为家庭作业。
words.en: A worksheet is a piece of paper on which problems or tasks are set for students or workers to solve or complete.

words.ex: She wore a dress made of cotton.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件棉质裙子。
words.en: Cotton is a plant that produces a soft fiber which is used to make cloth or thread. Cotton is also the cloth or thread that is made from this fiber.

words.ex: He wears a nylon jacket to stay dry.
words.ex_cn: 他穿一件尼龙夹克来保持干燥。
words.en: Nylon is a strong, elastic synthetic fiber used especially in the manufacture of clothing, ropes, and brushes.

words.ex: She knits a sweater from wool.
words.ex_cn: 她用羊毛织毛衣。
words.en: Wool is the hair that grows on sheep and some other animals, which is used to make clothes, blankets, etc.

words.tr:
n. 天鹅绒；丝绒
adj. 天鹅绒的
words.ex: The chair has a soft velvet cover.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子有柔软的丝绒坐垫。
words.en: A soft fabric with a thick short pile on one side, used for clothing and upholstery.

words.ex: She wears a silk dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件丝绸连衣裙去参加派对。
words.en: A fine, strong, soft, lustrous fiber produced by silkworms in making cocoons and collected to make thread and fabric.

words.ex: The boy picked up a piece of rubber from the floor.
words.ex_cn: 男孩从地上捡起一块橡胶。
words.en: Rubber is a strong, waterproof, elastic substance made from the juice of some tropical plants or artificially. It is used for making tires, boots, and many other products.

words.ex: He bought timber to build a fence.
words.ex_cn: 他买了木材来建篱笆。
words.en: Wood prepared for use in building and carpentry.

words.tr: phrase. 木材的纹理图案；指木材中纤维的排列方式所形成的自然条纹或图案
words.ex: The grain pattern of timber shows natural lines.
words.ex_cn: 木材的纹理显示出自然的纹路。
words.en: The natural arrangement of lines and textures in wood, often visible on its surface.

words.tr:
n. 模型；模特；模范；型号；
v. 将…做成模型；当模特；
words.ex: The architect built a model of the new building.
words.ex_cn: 建筑师制作了新大楼的模型。
words.en: A model is a person whose job is to wear and show new styles of clothes and other products, or a representation of something, often on a smaller scale, or a particular design or type of product.

words.ex: The tiger has black stripes on its orange fur.
words.ex_cn: 老虎的橙色皮毛上有黑色条纹。
words.en: A stripe is a long, narrow band or strip differing in color or texture from the surface on either side of it.

words.ex: The pattern of the wallpaper is very simple.
words.ex_cn: 墙纸的图案非常简单。
words.en: A pattern is the repeated or regular way in which something happens or is done.

words.ex: The texture of the bread is soft and fluffy.
words.ex_cn: 这种面包的质地柔软蓬松。
words.en: The feel, appearance, or consistency of a surface or a substance.

words.ex: The size of the box is too big for the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子的大小对架子来说太大了。
words.en: The physical dimensions, proportions, magnitude, or extent of an object.

words.tr:
n. 媒介；方法；
adj. 中等的；适中的；
words.ex: TV is a popular medium for advertising.
words.ex_cn: 电视是一种流行的广告媒介。
words.en: A medium is a method or way of expressing something.

words.tr:
n. 平均数；平均水平；
adj. 平均的；普通的；
v. 平均为…；
words.ex: The average of 4, 5, and 6 is 5.
words.ex_cn: 4、5和6的平均数是5。
words.en: An average is the result that you get when you add two or more numbers together and divide the total by the number of numbers you added together.

words.tr:
n. 需求；要求；
v. 要求；需求；
words.ex: The demand for clean water is increasing.
words.ex_cn: 对清洁水的需求正在增加。
words.en: If you demand something, you ask for it very forcefully, often because you think you have a right to do so.

words.tr:
n. 供应；供给；
v. 供给；
words.ex: The city needs a steady supply of water.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市需要稳定的供水。
words.en: If you supply someone with something that they want or need, you give them a quantity of it.

words.tr: n. 有价值的人或物；长处；
words.ex: He is an asset to the team because he works hard.
words.ex_cn: 他是个有价值的人，因为他工作努力。
words.en: An asset is something valuable that an individual, corporation, or country owns or controls with the expectation that it will provide a future benefit.

words.ex: The store sells many kinds of goods.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售各种商品。
words.en: Goods are items that are made to be sold.

words.tr:
n. 样品；样本；
v. 抽样；
words.ex: The scientist tested the sample from the river.
words.ex_cn: 科学家测试了来自河流的样品。
words.en: A sample is a small quantity of a product, especially food, given to customers so that they can try it before buying it.

words.tr: phrase. 家用电器（指家庭中使用的电力驱动设备，如冰箱、洗衣机、微波炉等）
words.ex: He fixed the household electrical appliances after they stopped working.
words.ex_cn: 家里的电器坏了之后，他修好了它们。
words.en: Electrical devices used in homes for various tasks such as cooking, cleaning, or entertainment.

words.ex: He picked up the parcel from the post office.
words.ex_cn: 他从邮局取了包裹。
words.en: A parcel is something wrapped in paper, usually so that it can be sent to someone by post.

words.tr:
v. 包装；收拾行李；
n. 包裹；小包；
words.ex: She packs the gift in colorful paper.
words.ex_cn: 她用彩纸包装礼物。
words.en: A pack is a container of a particular kind, especially one made of strong paper or plastic and containing a number of the same items. As a verb, pack means to put something into a container, especially in a neat and efficient way.

words.tr:
n. 包；包裹；
v. 包装；
words.ex: He bought a package of cookies.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一包饼干。
words.en: A package is a wrapped container or a set of objects wrapped in paper or packed in a box.

words.tr: n. 化妆品；美容品；“cosmetic”的复数；
words.ex: She buys cosmetics at the drugstore.
words.ex_cn: 她在药店买化妆品。
words.en: Substances or treatments used to enhance or alter the appearance of the face or body.

words.ex: I bought a souvenir from the beach.
words.ex_cn: 我从海边买了一个纪念品。
words.en: A souvenir is something which you buy or keep to remind you of a holiday, place, or event.

words.tr: phrase. 日常必需品；日常生活不可或缺的东西
words.ex: Water is a daily necessity for everyone.
words.ex_cn: 水是每个人每天的必需品。
words.en: A daily necessity refers to something that is essential or required on a daily basis for living or functioning properly.

words.ex: She bought a new perfume for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对买了一瓶新香水。
words.en: A perfume is a pleasant-smelling liquid which people put on their skin to make themselves smell nice.

words.ex: He bought new stationery for school.
words.ex_cn: 他为学校买了新的文具。
words.en: Stationery refers to the materials used for writing, such as paper, pens, and envelopes.

words.ex: He spilled ink on his shirt.
words.ex_cn: 他把墨水洒在了衬衫上。
words.en: Ink is the colored liquid used for writing, printing, or drawing.

words.ex: He picked up a paper clip from the desk.
words.ex_cn: 他从桌子上捡起一个回形针。
words.en: A small piece of bent wire or plastic used for holding sheets of paper together.

words.tr: n. 气球；热气球；玩具气球；球状物；
words.ex: The child held a red balloon at the party.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在派对上拿着一个红色的气球。
words.en: A balloon is a small, thin, rubber bag that you blow air into so that it becomes larger and rounder or longer. Balloons are used as toys or decorations.

words.ex: She tied the box with a thin string.
words.ex_cn: 她用一根细线把盒子绑了起来。
words.en: A string is a thin piece of rope or cord, or a series of things connected together.

words.ex: He collects bottle tops from soda bottles.
words.ex_cn: 他收集苏打水瓶的瓶盖。
words.en: The cap or lid that seals the opening of a bottle.

words.ex: He learned metal work in his technical class.
words.ex_cn: 他在技术课上学习了金属加工。
words.en: The craft or process of working with metals, such as forging, welding, or casting.

words.tr:
n. 框架；结构；骨架；模式；
v. 表达；陷害；
words.ex: The picture is in a wooden frame.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画在一个木制框架里。
words.en: A frame is a structure that forms a border or support for something, such as a picture or a window. It can also refer to the process of making or constructing something, or the act of falsely incriminating someone.

words.ex: He bought a leather jacket for winter.
words.ex_cn: 他冬天买了一件皮夹克。
words.en: Leather is a material made from the skin of an animal by tanning or a similar process.

words.tr:
v. 隐藏；躲藏；
n. 兽皮；
words.ex: He hides the key under the mat.
words.ex_cn: 他把钥匙藏在垫子下面。
words.en: To conceal something or someone from view or discovery.

words.ex: The factory uses raw material to make plastic.
words.ex_cn: 工厂用原材料制造塑料。
words.en: Raw material refers to the basic material from which a product is made.

words.ex: A hammer is a useful tool for fixing things.
words.ex_cn: 锤子是修理东西的有用工具。
words.en: A tool is any instrument or simple piece of equipment that you hold in your hands and use to do a particular kind of work.

words.tr: n. 马达；发动机；机动车；
words.ex: The car has a strong motor.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有一个强大的马达。
words.en: A motor is a device that changes energy into mechanical motion, especially such a device that provides power for a vehicle or for another device with moving parts.

words.ex: A car has many components, like wheels and engines.
words.ex_cn: 汽车有许多部分，比如轮子和发动机。
words.en: A component is a part of a larger whole, especially a part that can be separated from or attached to a system.

words.tr: phrase. 后轮；车辆后部的轮子
words.ex: The car's rear wheels slipped on the ice.
words.ex_cn: 汽车的后轮在冰上打滑了。
words.en: The wheels at the back of a vehicle.

words.ex: The car has a strong engine.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有一个强劲的发动机。
words.en: An engine is a machine that converts energy into mechanical force and motion.

words.tr:
n. 刹车；制动器
v. 刹车
words.ex: He pressed the brake to stop the car.
words.ex_cn: 他踩了刹车来停车。
words.en: A brake is a device in a vehicle that makes it go slower or stop.

words.tr: n. 一束；一串；一群；大量
words.ex: A bunch of birds flew over the tree.
words.ex_cn: 一群鸟飞过树顶。
words.en: A bunch of things is a group of them. A bunch of people is a group of them who are together or who are connected in some way.

words.ex: He uses a wheel chair to move around.
words.ex_cn: 他使用轮椅行动。
words.en: A chair with wheels designed for mobility, often used by people with disabilities.

words.ex: She put the apples in a plastic container.
words.ex_cn: 她把苹果放进了一个塑料容器里。
words.en: A container is something such as a box or bottle that is used to hold or store things in.

words.ex: She wears a necklace made of crystal.
words.ex_cn: 她戴一条水晶制成的项链。
words.en: A crystal is a solid that has a regular, repeating arrangement of atoms. Crystals are often transparent and can be used in jewelry or as decorative objects.

words.tr:
n. 烤架；铁格子
v. 烧烤；拷问
words.ex: He cooked the burgers on the grill.
words.ex_cn: 他用烤架烤了汉堡。
words.en: To cook food on a metal frame over a fire, or a metal frame used for cooking food in this way.

words.ex: The heat indicator shows when the pan is hot.
words.ex_cn: 热指示器显示锅是否热了。
words.en: A device or scale used to measure and display temperature levels.

words.ex: He is chewing gum during class.
words.ex_cn: 他上课时在嚼口香糖。
words.en: Chewing gum is a type of gum made for chewing but not swallowing, often flavored and sometimes used for freshening breath.

words.ex: He put a mat on the floor to keep it clean.
words.ex_cn: 他在地上放了一块垫子以保持清洁。
words.en: A mat is a piece of thick fabric or other material that is placed on a floor or other surface to protect it or to provide a soft surface to stand or sit on.

words.ex: He hammered the nail into the wood.
words.ex_cn: 他把钉子敲进了木头里。
words.en: A nail is a thin pointed piece of metal that is hammered into materials as a fastener. It can also refer to the hard covering at the end of fingers and toes. As a verb, to nail means to fasten something with a nail or to catch or accomplish something successfully.

words.ex: He put the lid on the box.
words.ex_cn: 他把盖子盖在盒子上。
words.en: A lid is a cover for a container, or the movable cover of the eye, known as the eyelid.

words.ex: They took a charter flight to the island.
words.ex_cn: 他们乘坐包机去了那个岛屿。
words.en: A charter flight is a flight that is not part of an airline's regular schedule, but is specially arranged for a particular group of people or for a particular purpose.

words.ex: She sells handmade handicraft at the market.
words.ex_cn: 她在市场上出售手工制品。
words.en: Handicraft refers to activities where useful and decorative objects are made completely by hand or by using only simple tools.

words.ex: The baby sleeps in a baby cot.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿睡在婴儿床里。
words.en: A baby cot is a small bed specifically designed for infants and very young children, typically with high sides to prevent the child from falling out.

words.ex: The bridge is made of iron.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥是用铁建造的。
words.en: Iron is a strong hard metal that is used to make steel and is also found in small quantities in blood and food.

words.ex: She buys soft fabrics for her dresses.
words.ex_cn: 她为自己的连衣裙购买柔软的布料。
words.en: Fabrics are materials made by weaving or knitting fibers together, used for making clothes, curtains, etc., or the structure or foundation of something.

words.ex: He wears a helmet when he rides a bike.
words.ex_cn: 他骑自行车时戴头盔。
words.en: A helmet is a strong, hard hat which is worn to protect your head.

words.ex: The quality of this phone is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机的质量很高。
words.en: The standard of something as measured against other things of a similar kind; the degree of excellence of something.

words.tr:
adj. 糟糕的；可怕的；
adv. 非常；极其；
words.ex: The weather today is awful.
words.ex_cn: 今天的天气很糟糕。
words.en: If you say that something is awful, you mean that it is extremely unpleasant, shocking, or bad.

words.ex: The smelly trash made everyone cover their noses.
words.ex_cn: 那堆难闻的垃圾让每个人都捂住了鼻子。
words.en: Having a strong, unpleasant smell.

words.ex: He ate a moderate amount of food.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了适量的食物。
words.en: If you moderate something or if it moderates, it becomes less extreme or violent, or if you moderate a discussion, you help the people in it to reach an agreement.

words.ex: He uses an efficient way to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他用一种高效的方法解决数学问题。
words.en: If something or someone is efficient, they are able to do tasks successfully, without wasting time or energy.

words.ex: Rare birds can be seen in this forest.
words.ex_cn: 这种森林里可以看到稀有的鸟类。
words.en: Something that is rare is not common and is therefore interesting or valuable.

words.ex: He bought a second-hand bike for $20.
words.ex_cn: 他花20美元买了一辆二手自行车。
words.en: used, owned, or worn by someone else before; not new.

words.tr: adj. 必需的；基本的；本质的；
words.ex: Water is essential for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命是必需的。
words.en: Something that is essential is extremely important or absolutely necessary to a particular subject, situation, or activity.

words.ex: This necklace is precious to her.
words.ex_cn: 这条项链对她来说很珍贵。
words.en: If you say that something such as a resource is precious, you mean that it is valuable and should not be wasted or used badly.

words.ex: Wearing blue jeans is fashionable now.
words.ex_cn: 现在穿牛仔裤很时髦。
words.en: Something that is fashionable is popular or approved of at a particular time.

words.ex: The teacher gave a satisfactory grade.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了一个令人满意的分数。
words.en: If something is satisfactory, it is good enough or acceptable.

words.ex: The river is dangerous for children.
words.ex_cn: 这条河对孩子来说很危险。
words.en: If something is dangerous, it is able or likely to hurt or harm you.

words.tr: adj. 锋利的；骤变的；灵敏的；尖刻的；
words.ex: The knife is sharp enough to cut paper.
words.ex_cn: 这把刀足够锋利，可以切纸。
words.en: Having a thin edge or a fine point that is capable of cutting or piercing; keen.

words.tr: adj. 正确的；合适的；正当的；
words.ex: This is the proper way to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 这是解决这个问题的正确方法。
words.en: If something is proper, it is suitable or correct for a particular purpose, situation, or person.

words.tr:
adj. 平滑的；平坦的；
v. 使平滑；
words.ex: The glass surface is smooth.
words.ex_cn: 玻璃表面是平滑的。
words.en: Having an even and regular surface or consistency; free from projections, indentations, or roughness.

words.ex: The pillow is soft and comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 这个枕头很软，很舒服。
words.en: Something that is soft is pleasant to touch, and not rough or hard.

words.tr: adj. 负面的；消极的；否定的；
words.ex: The news had a negative effect on the market.
words.ex_cn: 这条新闻对市场产生了负面影响。
words.en: If someone is negative or has a negative attitude, they consider only the bad aspects of a situation, rather than the good ones.

words.ex: The phone is expensive.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机很贵。
words.en: Costing a lot of money; having a high price.

words.ex: The new phone is too costly for me.
words.ex_cn: 这部新手机对我来说太贵了。
words.en: If you say that something is costly, you mean that it costs a lot of money, often more than you would want to pay.

words.tr: adj. 亲爱的；昂贵的；宝贵的；
words.ex: Dear friend, I miss you so much.
words.ex_cn: 亲爱的朋友，我非常想念你。
words.en: If someone or something is dear to you, it means you have a lot of affection for them or it is very important to you.

words.ex: She is an attractive woman.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个有吸引力的女性。
words.en: An attractive person or thing is pleasing or appealing to look at.

words.ex: This medicine is effective against colds.
words.ex_cn: 这种药对感冒有效。
words.en: Something that is effective works well and produces the results that were intended.

words.ex: He is a conservative man who likes old traditions.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个喜欢古老传统的保守男子。
words.en: A conservative person or group is one that does not like changes or new ideas, especially in politics or religion.

words.ex: The flowers in the garden are artificial.
words.ex_cn: 花园里的花是人造的。
words.en: Made or produced by human beings rather than occurring naturally, especially as a copy of something natural.

words.ex: He is a wealthy man who owns many houses.
words.ex_cn: 他是个富有的人，拥有许多房子。
words.en: A wealthy person, organization, or country has a lot of money, resources, or assets.

words.tr:
adj. 特别受喜爱的；
n. 特别喜爱的事物；
words.ex: Chocolate is my favourite dessert.
words.ex_cn: 巧克力是我最喜爱的甜点。
words.en: Something or someone that is preferred above all others.

words.ex: He gave a reasonable answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了一个合理的回答。
words.en: Fair and sensible; not excessive or extreme.

words.ex: This chair is very comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子非常舒适。
words.en: If a piece of furniture or an item of clothing is comfortable, it makes you feel physically relaxed when you use it or wear it, for example because it is soft.

words.tr:
adj. 复杂的；
n. 综合楼（群）；
words.ex: The instructions are too complex for children.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明对孩子来说太复杂了。
words.en: Something that is complex has many different parts, and is therefore often difficult to understand.

words.ex: This information is relevant to our project.
words.ex_cn: 这些信息与我们的项目相关。
words.en: Something that is relevant to a situation or person is important or significant in that situation or to that person.

words.ex: The lake is a man-made pond.
words.ex_cn: 这个湖是一个人工池塘。
words.en: Made or caused by human beings rather than occurring naturally.

words.tr:
adj. 化学的；
n. 化学品；
words.ex: The lab has a chemical reaction.
words.ex_cn: 实验室里有一个化学反应。
words.en: A chemical is a substance that is used in or produced by a process involving chemistry.

words.ex: He is a reliable friend who always helps.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个可靠的朋友，总是帮忙。
words.en: Able to be trusted to do or provide what is needed or right.

words.ex: This shirt is cheap and nice.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫又便宜又好看。
words.en: If something is cheap, it costs less money than usual or than you expected.

words.ex: This store sells inexpensive clothes.
words.ex_cn: 这家店卖不贵的衣服。
words.en: Something that is inexpensive does not cost a lot of money.

words.ex: This painting has a distinctive style.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画有独特的风格。
words.en: Something that is distinctive has a special quality or feature which makes it easily recognizable and different from other things of the same type.

words.ex: The painting is considered a masterpiece by art critics.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画被艺术评论家视为杰作。
words.en: A masterpiece is a work of art such as a painting, film, or book that is made with great skill and is considered to be the best work of a particular artist or writer.

words.tr: adj. 现实的；现实主义的；
words.ex: He made a realistic plan to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他制定了一个现实的存钱计划。
words.en: If you are realistic about a situation, you recognize and accept its true nature and try to deal with it in a practical way.

words.ex: This tool is useful for solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具对解决数学问题很有用。
words.en: If something is useful, you can use it to do something or to help you in some way.

words.tr: adj. 实用的；实际的；实践的；
words.ex: This tool is practical for everyday use.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具日常使用很实用。
words.en: relating to what is real rather than to what is possible or imagined; likely to succeed or be effective in real circumstances; involving or concerned with experience or actual use; not theoretical

words.tr: adj. 有价值的；贵重的；值钱的；
words.ex: This old book is valuable to historians.
words.ex_cn: 这本旧书对历史学家来说很有价值。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as valuable, you mean that they are very useful and helpful.

words.tr:
adj. 固体的；坚固的；可靠的；
n. 固体；
words.ex: Ice is a solid form of water.
words.ex_cn: 冰是水的固体形式。
words.en: A solid substance or object stays the same shape whether it is in a container or not.

words.ex: The glass is transparent.
words.ex_cn: 这玻璃是透明的。
words.en: If something is transparent, you can see through it.

words.tr: phrase. 多功能的；用途广泛的函数
words.ex: This app has a versatile function for work and play.
words.ex_cn: 这个应用程序具有适用于工作和娱乐的多功能性。
words.en: A feature or capability that can be adapted or used for many different purposes or tasks, making it highly flexible and useful.

words.ex: This machine is labour-saving.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器节省人力。
words.en: Designed to reduce the amount of work or effort needed to accomplish a task.

words.ex: This book is helpful for learning English.
words.ex_cn: 这本书对学习英语有帮助。
words.en: If you describe someone as helpful, you mean that they help you in some way, such as doing part of your job for you or by giving you advice or information.

words.ex: The shirt is well-fitting and comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫合身又舒适。
words.en: Describes something that fits someone or something very well, especially clothes or shoes.

words.tr: adj. 老式的；老派的；守旧的
words.ex: He wears an old-fashioned hat.
words.ex_cn: 他戴着一顶过时的帽子。
words.en: If you describe something as old-fashioned, you mean that it is no longer modern, current, or fashionable.

words.ex: He has a range of hobbies, like swimming and painting.
words.ex_cn: 他有很多爱好，比如游泳和画画。
words.en: A variety or assortment of things.

words.tr: adj. 精密复杂的；老练的；
words.ex: The phone has a sophisticated camera.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机有一个精密复杂的摄像头。
words.en: A sophisticated person is intelligent and knows a lot, so that they are able to understand complicated situations. A sophisticated machine, device, or method is more advanced or complex than others.

words.ex: The sunset over the mountains was magnificent.
words.ex_cn: 山上的日落壮丽极了。
words.en: If you say that something or someone is magnificent, you mean that you think they are extremely good, beautiful, or impressive.

words.tr: adj. 外来的；外国来的；奇异的；
words.ex: The market sells exotic fruits from other countries.
words.ex_cn: 这个市场出售来自其他国家的外来水果。
words.en: Something that is exotic is unusual and interesting because it comes from or is related to a distant country.

words.tr: adj. 极好的；令人震惊的； v. “stun”的现在分词；
words.ex: She wore a stunning dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件极好的裙子去参加派对。
words.en: Extremely impressive or attractive.

words.tr: adj. 狭窄的； v. “cramp”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The tiny room was cramped and hard to move in.
words.ex_cn: 这个小房间很狭窄，很难活动。
words.en: If a place is cramped, it is not big enough for the people or things in it, so that it is difficult to move around or to use things properly.

words.ex: This shirt is suitable for the party.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫适合这场派对。
words.en: Something that is suitable for a particular person or thing is right or acceptable for them.

words.tr: adj. 最先进的；达到最高水平的
words.ex: This hospital has state-of-the-art equipment.
words.ex_cn: 这家医院拥有最先进的设备。
words.en: The most advanced or sophisticated level of development, as of a device, technique, or scientific field, achieved at a particular time.

words.ex: The pen has a retractable tip.
words.ex_cn: 这支笔有一个可缩回的笔尖。
words.en: A retractable object is one that can be drawn back or in.

words.tr: adj. 呈弯曲状的；弧形的； v. （使）弯成弧形；“curve”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The road is curved around the hill.
words.ex_cn: 这条路沿着山呈弯曲状。
words.en: Having the shape of a curve; not straight.

words.ex: The earthquake caused tremendous damage.
words.ex_cn: 地震造成了巨大的破坏。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as tremendous, you mean that they are very great in amount, extent, or intensity.

words.ex: A pocket calculator is handy for math problems.
words.ex_cn: 便携式计算器对于数学问题很方便。
words.en: If something is handy, it is useful and easy to use or to reach.

words.tr:
n. 分数；得分；总谱；乐谱；
v. 得分；
words.ex: He got a high score on the math test.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学考试中得了高分。
words.en: If you score a particular amount or number in a game or test, you achieve that amount or number.

words.ex: We ate dinner at a small restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 我们在一家小餐厅吃了晚饭。
words.en: A restaurant is a place where you can eat a meal and pay for it. In restaurants, your food is usually served to you at your table by a waiter or waitress.

words.ex: The waiter brought us water and menus.
words.ex_cn: 服务员给我们端来了水和菜单。
words.en: A waiter is a man who works in a restaurant, serving people with food and drink.

words.ex: The waitress brought us water and menus.
words.ex_cn: 女服务员给我们端来了水和菜单。
words.en: A waitress is a woman who works in a restaurant, serving food and drink to customers.

words.tr: n. 自助餐厅；自助食堂；
words.ex: We ate lunch in the school cafeteria.
words.ex_cn: 我们在学校自助餐厅吃午饭。
words.en: A cafeteria is a type of food service location within an institution in which there is little or no waiting staff table service, whether a restaurant or within an institution such as a large office building or school; a school dining location is also referred to as a dining hall or canteen (in British English).

words.ex: He buys a sandwich at the snack bar.
words.ex_cn: 他在小吃吧买了一个三明治。
words.en: A snack bar is a small establishment or counter where light meals, snacks, and drinks are served.

words.tr: phrase. 餐饮服务；提供饮食和相关服务的业务
words.ex: The hotel offers a catering service for weddings.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店为婚礼提供餐饮服务。
words.en: A catering service is a business that provides food and drink for events such as weddings, parties, and corporate gatherings.

words.ex: He buys lunch in the school canteen.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校食堂买午餐。
words.en: A canteen is a place in a factory, office, or school where meals are served, often at a lower cost than in restaurants. It can also refer to a small container for carrying water or other drinks.

words.ex: The students eat lunch in the refectory.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在食堂吃午饭。
words.en: A refectory is a dining hall, especially in a monastery, college, or other institution.

words.ex: We eat dinner in the dining room.
words.ex_cn: 我们在餐厅吃晚饭。
words.en: A dining room is a room in a house where people eat their meals.

words.ex: The students gathered in the hall for the assembly.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在大厅里集合。
words.en: A hall is a large room or building which is used for public events such as concerts, exhibitions, and meetings.

words.ex: We eat at a take-away restaurant every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 我们每周五在快餐店吃饭。
words.en: A take-away restaurant is a place where you can buy food to eat somewhere else, rather than eating it in the restaurant.

words.ex: He takes away the toys after playtime.
words.ex_cn: 他玩完后把玩具拿走。
words.en: To remove something from a place or to subtract a number or amount from another.

words.ex: We had dinner at a buffet with many dishes to choose from.
words.ex_cn: 我们在自助餐吃了晚饭，有很多菜可以选。
words.en: A buffet is a meal consisting of several dishes from which guests serve themselves. As a verb, to buffet means to strike repeatedly and violently.

words.tr: phrase. 自动售货机；自动贩卖机
words.ex: He bought a soda from the vending machine.
words.ex_cn: 他从自动售货机买了一罐苏打水。
words.en: A vending machine is a machine from which you can get things such as cigarettes, chocolate, or coffee by putting in money and pressing a button.

words.tr:
adj. 免下车即可得到服务的
n. 免下车餐馆；免下车电影院；免下车商业场所
words.ex: We ate burgers at a drive-in last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚在汽车餐厅吃了汉堡。
words.en: A drive-in is a place such as a restaurant or cinema where you can be served or watch a film without leaving your car.

words.ex: He looked at the menu and chose pasta.
words.ex_cn: 他看了菜单，选择了意大利面。
words.en: A menu is a list of the food that is available at a restaurant or café.

words.ex: She put the food on a clean plate.
words.ex_cn: 她把食物放在一个干净的盘子里。
words.en: A flat dish, typically circular and made of china, from which food is eaten or served.

words.ex: He ate soup from a bowl.
words.ex_cn: 他从碗里吃汤。
words.en: A bowl is a round container with a wide uncovered top. Some kinds of bowl are used, for example, for serving or eating food from, or in cooking, while other larger kinds are often used for washing or other purposes.

words.ex: He drank water from a cup.
words.ex_cn: 他从杯子里喝水。
words.en: A cup is a small round container that you drink from. Cups usually have handles and are made from china or plastic.

words.ex: He placed the cups on a tray.
words.ex_cn: 他把杯子放在一个托盘上。
words.en: A tray is a flat container, usually made of wood, plastic, or metal, with raised edges, used for carrying things such as food or drinks.

words.tr:
n. 叉子；分岔；分支
v. 分岔；用叉子叉
words.ex: He picked up a fork to eat his pasta.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起叉子吃意大利面。
words.en: A fork is a tool used for eating or serving food, consisting of a handle with several narrow tines on one end. It can also refer to a division into two or more branches or directions.

words.ex: He cut the bread with a knife.
words.ex_cn: 他用刀切面包。
words.en: A knife is a tool for cutting or a weapon, consisting of a flat piece of metal with a sharp edge on the end of a handle.

words.ex: He picked up a spoon to eat the soup.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起一把勺子喝汤。
words.en: A spoon is an object used for eating, stirring, and serving food. It has a small shallow bowl on a handle.

words.ex: He wiped his mouth with a napkin.
words.ex_cn: 他用纸巾擦了擦嘴。
words.en: A napkin is a piece of cloth or paper used at meals to protect your clothes and to wipe your mouth and fingers.

words.ex: The tip of the pencil broke off.
words.ex_cn: 铅笔的尖端断了。
words.en: The end of a pointed or projecting object; a sum of money given to someone as a reward for their services; to give someone a small amount of money as a reward for their services.

words.ex: He eats healthy food every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃健康的食物。
words.en: Food is what people and animals eat to live and grow.

words.ex: The car needs a new starter to start the engine.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车需要一个新的启动器来发动引擎。
words.en: A starter is a person or thing that starts something, especially a device that initiates the operation of an engine or machine.

words.tr: phrase. 均衡饮食；指摄入各种适量的营养物质，保持营养全面而平衡的饮食方式
words.ex: He eats a balanced diet to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他吃均衡的饮食来保持健康。
words.en: A balanced diet is a diet that contains the proper proportions of carbohydrates, fats, proteins, vitamins, minerals, and water necessary to maintain good health.

words.ex: I ate a fresh salad for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 我午餐吃了一份新鲜的色拉。
words.en: A salad is a mixture of raw vegetables such as lettuce, cucumber, and tomatoes, often served with a dressing.

words.ex: He ate a piece of chocolate after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后吃了一块巧克力。
words.en: A food preparation in the form of a paste or solid block made from roasted and ground cacao seeds, typically sweetened.

words.tr: n. 海产食物（如海鱼、贝类等）；
words.ex: We ate fresh seafood at the seaside restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 我们在海边的餐厅吃了新鲜的海产食物。
words.en: Seafood refers to fish and shellfish from the sea that are eaten as food.

words.ex: He bought a fresh herring at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了一条新鲜的青鱼。
words.en: A herring is a long silver-colored fish. Herring live in large groups in the sea.

words.tr: n. 柠檬汽水；柠檬饮料
words.ex: He drinks lemonade every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 他每天下午喝柠檬水。
words.en: A drink made from lemon juice, water, and sugar.

words.ex: He eats lean meat to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他吃瘦肉以保持健康。
words.en: Lean meat refers to meat that contains little fat, making it a healthier option for those looking to reduce their fat intake.

words.ex: He eats cheese every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃奶酪。
words.en: Cheese is a food made from the pressed curds of milk, often with added flavorings and sometimes with a hard or soft texture.

words.ex: She baked a chocolate cake for her birthday.
words.ex_cn: 她为生日烤了一个巧克力蛋糕。
words.en: A cake is a sweet food made by baking a mixture of flour, eggs, sugar, and fat in an oven. Cakes may be large and cut into slices or small and intended for one person only.

words.ex: He eats a hamburger for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃一个汉堡包。
words.en: A hamburger is a cooked patty of ground meat, usually beef, placed inside a sliced bread roll or bun.

words.ex: He eats a sandwich for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃三明治。
words.en: A sandwich consists of two slices of bread with a layer of food such as cheese or meat between them.

words.ex: He drinks orange juice every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上喝橙汁。
words.en: The liquid obtained from or present in fruit or vegetables.

words.ex: He drinks mineral water every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天喝矿泉水。
words.en: Water that contains dissolved mineral salts, especially carbonates, sulfates, and phosphates of calcium, magnesium, sodium, and iron, and is often effervescent.

words.ex: He eats nut rice for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃坚果饭。
words.en: A food item, likely rice mixed with nuts or a dish named 'nut rice'.

words.ex: He eats lentil soup for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃扁豆汤。
words.en: A lentil is a small, flat, round seed that is cooked and eaten as a food. It is a type of legume.

words.ex: He eats curry every Friday night.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五晚上吃咖喱。
words.en: Curry refers to a variety of dishes originating in the Indian subcontinent that use a complex combination of spices or herbs, usually including ground turmeric, cumin, coriander, ginger, and fresh or dried chilies. It also refers to the act of grooming a horse with a special comb.

words.ex: He cooks with olive oil every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都用橄榄油做饭。
words.en: Olive oil is a liquid fat obtained from olives, a traditional tree crop of the Mediterranean Basin. It is commonly used in cooking, for frying foods or as a salad dressing.

words.ex: I ate chicken for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我晚餐吃了鸡肉。
words.en: A chicken is a bird that is kept on a farm for its eggs and meat.

words.ex: She put honey on her toast.
words.ex_cn: 她在吐司上涂了蜂蜜。
words.en: Honey is a sweet, sticky, yellowish-brown fluid made by bees and other insects from nectar collected from flowers.

words.ex: He smokes a cigar after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后抽一支雪茄。
words.en: A cigar is a tightly rolled bundle of dried and fermented tobacco leaves, which is ignited so that its smoke may be drawn into the mouth.

words.ex: He eats beef for dinner every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日吃牛肉当晚餐。
words.en: Beef is the meat from a cow, bull, or ox. When people beef about something, they complain about it.

words.ex: The farmer feeds the lamb every morning.
words.ex_cn: 农夫每天早上喂羔羊。
words.en: A lamb is a young sheep.

words.ex: He eats pork for dinner every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日吃猪肉当晚餐。
words.en: Pork is meat from a pig, usually fresh and not smoked or salted.

words.ex: He ate a bowl of noodle for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃了一碗面条。
words.en: Noodles are a type of food made from unleavened dough which is rolled flat and cut, stretched or extruded, into long strips or strings.

words.ex: He bought a loaf of bread from the bakery.
words.ex_cn: 他从面包店买了一条面包。
words.en: Bread is a food made from flour, water, and usually yeast, mixed together and baked.

words.tr: n. 比萨饼；披萨；意大利薄饼；
words.ex: I ate a pizza for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我晚餐吃了一块比萨饼。
words.en: A pizza is a flat, round piece of dough baked with tomato, cheese, and sometimes other ingredients on top.

words.ex: He eats french fries with ketchup.
words.ex_cn: 他吃薯条时配番茄酱。
words.en: French fries are long, thin pieces of potato that are fried until they are crisp and golden brown.

words.tr: n. 炸马铃薯条；碎片( chip的名词复数；
words.ex: I would like some chips with my burger.
words.ex_cn: 我想要一些炸薯条配我的汉堡。
words.en: Chips are thin slices of potato that are fried until they are hard and crunchy and are usually eaten cold as a snack.

words.tr: phrase. 热狗（面包夹熏红肠）
words.ex: He eats a hot dog at the park.
words.ex_cn: 他在公园里吃热狗。
words.en: A hot dog is a cooked sausage, traditionally grilled or steamed and served in a sliced bun as a sandwich.

words.tr: phrase. 蛋卷；一种中式炸春卷，通常包含蔬菜和肉类馅料
words.ex: He ate an egg roll for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃了一个春卷。
words.en: An egg roll is a cylindrical, savory roll with shredded cabbage, chopped pork, and other fillings inside a thickly-wrapped wheat flour skin, which is fried in hot oil.

words.ex: She spread butter on her toast.
words.ex_cn: 她在吐司上抹了黄油。
words.en: Butter is a pale yellow edible fatty substance made by churning cream and used as a spread or in cooking.

words.ex: She put jam on her bread for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 她早餐在面包上涂了果酱。
words.en: Jam is a sweet food made by boiling fruit with sugar until it is thick. It is usually spread on bread or toast. Jam can also refer to a situation where things are crowded or blocked, or the act of forcing something into a tight space.

words.ex: He ate eggs and bacon for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了鸡蛋和培根。
words.en: Bacon is a type of salt-cured pork made from various cuts, typically from the pork belly or from back cuts, which are less fatty than the belly.

words.ex: He ordered a steak for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐点了一份牛排。
words.en: A steak is a slice of meat, especially beef, that is cooked by grilling or frying.

words.ex: He ate ham for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了火腿。
words.en: Ham is meat from the upper part of a pig's leg that has been preserved with salt or smoke.

words.ex: He ate a sausage for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了一根香肠。
words.en: A sausage is a type of meat product usually made from ground meat, often pork, beef, or poultry, along with salt, spices, and other flavorings. Other ingredients such as grains or breadcrumbs may be included as fillers or extenders.

words.ex: We ate turkey for Thanksgiving dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我们在感恩节晚餐上吃了火鸡。
words.en: A turkey is a large bird that is often eaten at Christmas or Thanksgiving.

words.ex: He caught a crab at the beach.
words.ex_cn: 他在海滩上抓到一只蟹。
words.en: A crab is a sea creature with a flat round body covered by a shell, and five pairs of legs with large claws on the front pair. Crabs usually move sideways.

words.ex: He ate grilled shrimp for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐吃了烤虾。
words.en: A shrimp is a small shellfish with a long tail and many legs, which can be eaten as food.

words.ex: He ate a fresh oyster for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐吃了一个新鲜的牡蛎。
words.en: An oyster is a large flat shellfish. Some oysters can be eaten and others produce valuable objects called pearls.

words.ex: He eats a carrot every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃一根胡萝卜。
words.en: A carrot is a long, thin, orange-colored vegetable that grows underground.

words.ex: He eats chili with rice every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃辣椒配米饭。
words.en: Chili is a small, hot-tasting pod of a type of pepper, used in cooking to add flavor and heat to dishes.

words.ex: He eats a cucumber for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃了一根黄瓜。
words.en: A cucumber is a long, green vegetable with a high water content, used in salads and for pickling.

words.ex: He picked a wild mushroom in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 他在森林里摘了一朵野生蘑菇。
words.en: A mushroom is a fungus that grows in damp, dark places and has a stem with a rounded top.

words.ex: He eats a sweet potato for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐吃红薯。
words.en: A sweet potato is a root vegetable with a sweet taste and a soft texture when cooked. It is a rich source of vitamins, minerals, and fiber.

words.ex: He chopped an onion for the soup.
words.ex_cn: 他为汤切了一个洋葱。
words.en: An onion is a round vegetable with a light brown skin. It has many layers and a strong, sharp smell and taste.

words.ex: I eat broccoli with dinner every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天晚餐都吃西兰花。
words.en: Broccoli is a vegetable with a green flower head and a thick stalk, eaten as a vegetable.

words.ex: He eats cabbage every day for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他每天午餐都吃卷心菜。
words.en: A cabbage is a round vegetable with thick green leaves wrapped around its short stem.

words.ex: He eats cauliflower with dinner every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚餐都吃花椰菜。
words.en: Cauliflower is a large, round, white vegetable that is eaten cooked or raw.

words.ex: He eats celery every day for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他每天午餐都吃芹菜。
words.en: Celery is a vegetable with long pale green stalks. It is eaten raw in salads or cooked as a vegetable.

words.ex: He ate popcorn made from corn.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了用玉米做的爆米花。
words.en: Corn is a tall plant which produces long vegetables covered with yellow seeds. It is also a cereal crop.

words.ex: He adds garlic to the soup for flavor.
words.ex_cn: 他往汤里加蒜来提味。
words.en: A strong-smelling pungent-tasting bulb, used as a flavoring in cooking and in herbal medicine.

words.ex: She added lettuce to her sandwich.
words.ex_cn: 她在三明治里加了莴苣。
words.en: Lettuce is a plant with large green leaves that is eaten in salads.

words.ex: He eats peas with his dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他吃饭时吃豌豆。
words.en: Peas are small, round, green seeds which are eaten as a vegetable. They are the seeds of a climbing plant.

words.ex: He eats spinach every day for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚餐都吃菠菜。
words.en: Spinach is a leafy green vegetable that is high in iron and vitamins, often eaten cooked or raw in salads.

words.ex: The mulberry tree grows near the old house.
words.ex_cn: 桑树长在老房子附近。
words.en: A mulberry is a tree that produces small, sweet berries, which are often used in cooking or eaten fresh.

words.ex: He cooked a yam for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他为晚餐煮了一个薯蓣。
words.en: A yam is a root vegetable that is similar to a sweet potato and is often used in cooking.

words.ex: They drank champagne at the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 他们在婚礼上喝了香槟。
words.en: Champagne is an expensive French white wine with bubbles in. It is often drunk to celebrate something.

words.ex: The scientist created a cocktail of chemicals for the experiment.
words.ex_cn: 科学家为实验配制了一种化学混合物。
words.en: A cocktail is a mixed drink typically made with a combination of alcoholic beverages and other ingredients such as fruit juices, syrups, or cream.

words.tr: phrase. 酒精成瘾者；对酒精上瘾的人
words.ex: He is an alcohol addict who cannot stop drinking.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个无法戒酒的酒精成瘾者。
words.en: A person who is unable to stop drinking alcohol, often leading to physical or psychological dependence.

words.tr: phrase. 谷物；谷粒，指可食用的禾本科植物的种子，如小麦、水稻、玉米等
words.ex: Wheat is a common cereal grain used for bread.
words.ex_cn: 小麦是一种常用于制作面包的谷物。
words.en: A grass crop grown for its edible seeds, such as wheat, rice, or corn.

words.ex: Eating vegetables gives you good nutrition.
words.ex_cn: 吃蔬菜能提供良好的营养。
words.en: The process of providing or obtaining the food necessary for health and growth.

words.ex: He put sugar in his tea.
words.ex_cn: 他把糖放进茶里。
words.en: A sweet substance that is used to make food and drinks sweet. It is usually in the form of white or brown crystals.

words.ex: Eating fruits gives you vitamin C.
words.ex_cn: 吃水果可以给你维生素C。
words.en: A vitamin is one of a group of organic substances which are essential in small quantities to the nutrition of most animals and some plants, and which are present in natural foodstuffs or sometimes produced within the body.

words.ex: Bread and rice are rich in carbohydrate.
words.ex_cn: 面包和米饭富含碳水化合物。
words.en: A carbohydrate is a substance found in foods such as bread, potatoes, and rice which provides your body with heat and energy and which consists of carbon, hydrogen, and oxygen.

words.ex: He eats eggs for protein.
words.ex_cn: 他吃鸡蛋来获取蛋白质。
words.en: Proteins are large, complex molecules that play many critical roles in the body. They are necessary for the structure, function, and regulation of the body's tissues and organs.

words.ex: He eats eggs but watches his cholesterol.
words.ex_cn: 他吃鸡蛋，但注意自己的胆固醇。
words.en: Cholesterol is a substance that exists in the cells of the body and in blood, which can cause heart disease if there is too much of it.

words.tr:
n. 烤肉；烘烤；
adj. 烤的；焙的；
v. 烤；烘烤；
words.ex: We had roast for dinner last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚我们吃了烤肉。
words.en: To cook food, such as meat, in an oven or over a fire.

words.tr:
n. 梅子；李子；紫红色；青紫色；令人垂涎的东西
adj. 令人垂涎的；吸引人的
words.ex: He ate a ripe plum for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了一个熟透的李子。
words.en: A plum is a sweet, juicy fruit with a smooth, red or purple skin and a stone in the middle.

words.ex: He ate a bowl of chocolate pudding after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后吃了一碗巧克力布丁。
words.en: A pudding is a cooked sweet dish made with flour, fat, and eggs, and usually served hot.

words.ex: He ate a slice of apple pie for dessert.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一块苹果派作为甜点。
words.en: A pie is a baked dish which is usually made of a pastry dough casing that contains a filling of various sweet or savoury ingredients.

words.ex: He ate ice cream for dessert.
words.ex_cn: 他吃冰淇淋当甜食。
words.en: Dessert is a sweet course eaten at the end of a meal.

words.ex: He asked for the direction to the station.
words.ex_cn: 他问了去车站的方向。
words.en: A direction is the way that you have to travel to get from one place to another, or the way that something is moving or pointing.

words.ex: The hunter shot an arrow at the target.
words.ex_cn: 猎人向目标射了一支箭。
words.en: An arrow is a long thin weapon which is sharp and pointed at one end and which often has feathers at the other end. Arrows are shot from a bow.

words.tr:
v. 做标记；签名；
n. 征兆；手势；符号；标志；告示牌；
words.ex: Sign the box with a checkmark.
words.ex_cn: 用对勾在盒子上做标记。
words.en: A sign is a mark or shape that always has a particular meaning, for example in mathematics or music. It can also be an event, action, or fact that shows that something exists, is happening, or may happen in the future.

words.tr:
n. 反面；对立面；
adj. 对面的；
prep. 与…相对；
words.ex: The opposite of black is white.
words.ex_cn: 黑色的反面是白色。
words.en: If one thing is opposite another, it is on the other side of a space from it.

words.tr: n. 交叉；相交；十字路口；交叉路口；
words.ex: The intersection of two roads is busy.
words.ex_cn: 两条路的交叉口很繁忙。
words.en: An intersection is a place where roads or other lines meet or cross.

words.ex: The car stopped at a crossroad.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在交叉路口停了下来。
words.en: A crossroad is a place where two roads meet and cross each other, or a point at which an important decision must be made.

words.ex: The car stopped at the junction.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在交叉路口停了下来。
words.en: A junction is a place where two or more things, especially roads or railways, come together.

words.ex: He drove his car on the t-road to save time.
words.ex_cn: 他开车走T形路以节省时间。
words.en: A type of road junction, often found in the UK, where three roads meet, forming a 'T' shape, with one road ending at the intersection.

words.tr: phrase. 分叉路；岔道（指道路分成两条或更多方向的路口）
words.ex: He took the fork road to the left.
words.ex_cn: 他选择了左边的岔路。
words.en: A fork road is a place where a road splits into two or more directions.

words.ex: The path leads to the village.
words.ex_cn: 这条路通向村庄。
words.en: A path is a way or track designed for walking or traveling along, especially through the countryside.

words.ex: The pedestrian crossed the street at the zebra crossing.
words.ex_cn: 行人在斑马线处过马路。
words.en: A pedestrian is a person who is walking in a city, town, or village, especially along a pavement or in a pedestrian area.

words.tr: phrase. 斑马线：一种由一系列宽阔的白色条纹标记的人行横道，用于指示行人有优先通行权的过街点。
words.ex: The children walk across the zebra crossing.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们走过斑马线。
words.en: A zebra crossing is a place on the road that is marked with broad black and white stripes, where vehicles must stop to allow pedestrians to cross.

words.ex: Children play on the pavement after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在人行道上玩耍。
words.en: A pavement is a path with a hard surface, usually by the side of a road, that people walk on.

words.ex: He walks on the sidewalk every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都在人行道上走路。
words.en: A sidewalk is a path with a hard surface by the side of a road that people walk on.

words.ex: The car drove under the overpass.
words.ex_cn: 汽车从立交桥下开过。
words.en: An overpass is a bridge that carries one road or railway line over another.

words.tr: n. （铁路或公路下的）地下通道
words.ex: The dog ran under the underpass.
words.ex_cn: 狗从立交桥下跑过去了。
words.en: An underpass is a road or path that goes under another road or a railway.

words.tr:
n. 大楼；大厦；块；街区；障碍物；
v. 阻塞；阻碍；
words.ex: The new block is next to the park.
words.ex_cn: 这栋新大楼就在公园旁边。
words.en: A block is a large solid piece of material with flat surfaces on each side. As a verb, to block means to prevent movement or progress.

words.ex: The signpost shows the way to the village.
words.ex_cn: 路标指示了去村庄的路。
words.en: A signpost is a post with a sign on it, giving information such as the direction to a place or the distance to it.

words.ex: He got yellow fever while traveling in Africa.
words.ex_cn: 他在非洲旅行时感染了黄热病。
words.en: Yellow fever is a serious viral disease that is transmitted by mosquitoes, primarily in tropical regions of Africa and South America. It is characterized by fever, chills, severe headache, back pain, general body aches, nausea, and vomiting. In severe cases, it can cause liver damage leading to jaundice (which gives the disease its name), bleeding, and even death.

words.ex: The epidemic spread quickly across the country.
words.ex_cn: 这种流行病迅速蔓延到全国。
words.en: An epidemic is a large number of cases of an infectious disease occurring at the same time.

words.ex: He has a chronic cough that lasts for months.
words.ex_cn: 他有一个持续数月的慢性咳嗽。
words.en: A chronic illness or condition lasts for a long time and cannot be cured, but it can usually be controlled.

words.tr: adj. 敏锐的；急性的；严重的；
words.ex: He has an acute mind and solves problems quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他思维敏锐，能快速解决问题。
words.en: An acute problem or negative feeling is very severe.

words.ex: He has a toothache and cannot eat.
words.ex_cn: 他牙疼，不能吃东西。
words.en: A toothache is a pain in or around a tooth.

words.ex: He has a backache after lifting the box.
words.ex_cn: 他搬完箱子后背疼。
words.en: A backache is a pain in your back.

words.tr: n. 头痛；令人头痛的人（或事物）；
words.ex: He got a headache after working too long.
words.ex_cn: 他工作太长时间后得了头痛。
words.en: A headache is a pain in your head. If you say that something is a headache, you mean that it causes you difficulty or worry.

words.ex: He has back pain after lifting heavy boxes.
words.ex_cn: 他搬重箱子后背痛。
words.en: Pain felt in the back, often in the lower back.

words.ex: He had a stomachache after eating too much ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了太多冰淇淋后胃痛。
words.en: A stomachache is a pain in your stomach.

words.ex: He has a sore throat from singing too much.
words.ex_cn: 他因为唱太多歌而喉咙痛。
words.en: If you have a sore throat, your throat hurts and it is difficult for you to swallow.

words.ex: He has heart disease and must eat healthy food.
words.ex_cn: 他患有心脏病，必须吃健康的食物。
words.en: A condition that affects the heart and blood vessels, often leading to serious health issues.

words.tr: phrase. 流行性感冒（influenza 的简称）；由流感病毒引起的急性呼吸道传染病
words.ex: He stayed home because he had the flu.
words.ex_cn: 他因为得了流感待在家里。
words.en: An infectious disease caused by a virus, characterized by fever, chills, and muscle aches.

words.tr:
adj. 寒冷的；冰冷的；
n. 寒冷；
words.ex: The cold wind made me shiver.
words.ex_cn: 寒冷的风让我发抖。
words.en: Something that is cold has a low temperature, especially when compared to the temperature of the human body. It can also describe a lack of warmth in someone's behavior or a situation.

words.ex: He has a high fever and stays in bed.
words.ex_cn: 他发烧了，躺在床上休息。
words.en: A fever is a condition in which the body's temperature is higher than usual, often as a response to infection.

words.ex: He has asthma and cannot run fast.
words.ex_cn: 他有哮喘，不能跑快。
words.en: A respiratory condition marked by spasms in the bronchi of the lungs, causing difficulty in breathing. It usually results from an allergic reaction or other forms of hypersensitivity.

words.ex: He got pneumonia after a bad cold.
words.ex_cn: 他得了重感冒后患了肺炎。
words.en: Pneumonia is a serious disease which affects your lungs and makes it difficult for you to breathe.

words.ex: He has liver trouble from drinking too much.
words.ex_cn: 他因为喝酒太多而有肝脏问题。
words.en: Liver trouble refers to any disorder or disease affecting the liver, which can range from mild conditions like fatty liver to severe ones like cirrhosis.

words.ex: He has arthritis in his hands.
words.ex_cn: 他双手有关节炎。
words.en: Arthritis is a medical condition in which the joints in someone's body are swollen and painful.

words.ex: He has diabetes and must check his blood every day.
words.ex_cn: 他患有糖尿病，必须每天检查血糖。
words.en: A medical condition in which the body cannot produce enough insulin or cannot use insulin properly, leading to high levels of sugar in the blood.

words.ex: He had diarrhea after eating bad food.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了坏食物后得了腹泻。
words.en: A condition in which feces are discharged from the bowels frequently and in a liquid form.

words.ex: He got cholera from dirty water.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了脏水染上了霍乱。
words.en: Cholera is an infectious and often fatal bacterial disease of the small intestine, typically contracted from infected water supplies and causing severe vomiting and diarrhea.

words.ex: He was diagnosed with leprosy last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年被诊断出患有麻风病。
words.en: Leprosy is a chronic infectious disease caused by the bacterium Mycobacterium leprae, which primarily affects the skin, the peripheral nerves, mucosal surfaces of the upper respiratory tract, and the eyes.

words.ex: He has a high fever as a symptom of the flu.
words.ex_cn: 他发烧是流感的症状。
words.en: A symptom is a physical or mental feature which is regarded as indicating a condition of disease, particularly such a feature that is apparent to the patient.

words.tr: n. 综合征；综合症状；典型表现；
words.ex: He was diagnosed with sleep apnea syndrome.
words.ex_cn: 他被诊断出患有睡眠呼吸暂停综合征。
words.en: A syndrome is a set of medical signs and symptoms which are correlated with each other and often associated with a particular disease or disorder.

words.ex: He has an allergy to peanuts.
words.ex_cn: 他对花生过敏。
words.en: An allergy is a condition in which your immune system reacts abnormally to a foreign substance.

words.tr:
n. 咳嗽；
v. 咳嗽；
words.ex: He had a bad cough last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚咳得很厉害。
words.en: A cough is a sudden, forceful expulsion of air from the lungs, often caused by irritation in the airway.

words.tr: phrase. 流鼻涕且堵塞的鼻子
words.ex: He has a runny stuffy nose from the cold.
words.ex_cn: 他因为感冒而流鼻涕且鼻子堵塞。
words.en: A nose discharging mucus, often due to a cold or allergy.

words.ex: The wound caused a serious infection.
words.ex_cn: 伤口引起了严重的感染。
words.en: An infection is a disease caused by microorganisms such as bacteria, viruses, or parasites invading the body.

words.ex: He has insomnia and cannot sleep at night.
words.ex_cn: 他有失眠症，晚上睡不着。
words.en: If someone suffers from insomnia, they find it difficult to sleep.

words.ex: He vomited after eating bad food.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了坏食物后吐了。
words.en: To eject the contents of the stomach through the mouth.

words.ex: She feels chilly in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 她早上觉得冷。
words.en: To experience a sensation of coldness.

words.ex: He has an ulcer from eating too much spicy food.
words.ex_cn: 他因为吃太多辣食而得了溃疡。
words.en: An ulcer is a sore area on the skin or inside the body that is very painful and may bleed or produce a poisonous substance.

words.ex: He felt deep depression after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到深深的抑郁。
words.en: A period during which business, employment, and stock-market values decline severely or remain at a very low level of activity.

words.tr:
n. 压力；强调；
v. 着重；强调；
words.ex: He feels stress from too much work.
words.ex_cn: 他因为工作太多而感到压力。
words.en: Stress is a state of mental or emotional strain or tension resulting from adverse or demanding circumstances.

words.ex: He felt drowsiness after taking the medicine.
words.ex_cn: 他吃完药后感到困倦。
words.en: A state of feeling sleepy or lethargic, often leading to a desire to sleep.

words.ex: After running for an hour, he felt fatigue.
words.ex_cn: 跑了一个小时后，他感到疲乏。
words.en: A feeling of extreme physical or mental tiredness.

words.ex: He ate a lump of sugar.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一块糖。
words.en: A lump is a solid piece of something, often with no particular shape. If you lump things together, you put them together in a group or treat them as the same.

words.ex: He ate too much and had indigestion.
words.ex_cn: 他吃太多了，导致消化不良。
words.en: Indigestion is pain or discomfort in your stomach, usually after eating, which is caused by difficulty in digesting food.

words.tr: phrase. 扭伤的；扭歪的（指关节或肌肉因扭动过度而受伤）
words.ex: His ankle is still sprain twisted after the fall.
words.ex_cn: 他的脚踝在摔倒后仍然扭伤了。
words.en: An injury to a ligament, typically caused by a sudden twist or pull.

words.tr:
n. 肘部
v. 用肘推挤
words.ex: He hurt his elbow while playing basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他在打篮球时伤了肘部。
words.en: The joint between the forearm and the upper arm; to push someone with your elbow.

words.tr: n. 关节错位；脱臼；混乱
words.ex: The fall caused a dislocation in his shoulder.
words.ex_cn: 这次跌倒导致他的肩膀脱臼。
words.en: Dislocation refers to the displacement of something from its usual position or state, often used in the context of bones moving out of place in the body or the disruption of systems and structures.

words.ex: He has flat foot and needs special shoes.
words.ex_cn: 他有扁平足，需要特殊的鞋子。
words.en: A condition in which the foot has an arch that is lower than usual.

words.ex: He fractured his arm during the soccer game.
words.ex_cn: 他在足球比赛中摔断了手臂。
words.en: If something such as a bone fractures or is fractured, it breaks or cracks.

words.tr: phrase. 斜颈；扭颈（一种颈部肌肉痉挛导致头部歪斜的病症）
words.ex: He has a wry neck from sleeping wrong.
words.ex_cn: 他因为睡姿不对导致脖子歪了。
words.en: A condition in which the head is tilted to one side, often due to muscle spasm or injury.

words.tr: adj. 头晕目眩的；头昏眼花的；
words.ex: He felt dizzy after spinning around quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他快速转圈后感到头晕目眩。
words.en: If you feel dizzy, you feel that you are losing your balance and are about to fall.

words.ex: He has a stiff neck from sleeping wrong.
words.ex_cn: 他因为睡姿不对导致脖子僵硬。
words.en: A condition where the neck muscles are tight and painful, making it difficult to move the head.

words.ex: Obesity is a serious health problem in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 肥胖是许多国家的一个严重健康问题。
words.en: Obesity is a medical condition in which excess body fat has accumulated to the extent that it may have a negative effect on health.

words.tr: n. 痛性痉挛，抽筋( cramp的名词复数 ); （腹部）绞痛
words.ex: She had cramps after running too long.
words.ex_cn: 她跑太久后出现了抽筋。
words.en: Cramps are sudden, involuntary muscle contractions or over-shortening; while generally temporary and non-damaging, they can cause significant pain and a paralysis-like immobility of the affected muscle.

words.tr: v. 擦伤；挫伤；出现伤痕；
words.ex: He bruised his knee when he fell off the bike.
words.ex_cn: 他从自行车上摔下来时擦伤了膝盖。
words.en: A bruise is a mark that appears on your skin after you have been injured, but the skin is not broken.

words.ex: He is worried about his baldness.
words.ex_cn: 他担心自己的脱发。
words.en: The condition of having a scalp wholly or partly lacking hair.

words.ex: She is pregnant and will have a baby next month.
words.ex_cn: 她怀孕了，下个月就要生宝宝了。
words.en: Having a baby developing in the uterus.

words.ex: The doctor prescribed a drug for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 医生给他开了一种治疗头痛的药物。
words.en: A drug is a substance which is used to treat an illness, relieve a symptom, or modify a chemical process in the body for a specific purpose.

words.tr: n. 药物；药物治疗；药物处理；
words.ex: He took his medication every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃药。
words.en: Medication refers to a substance used for medical treatment, especially a medicine or drug.

words.ex: He wants to study medicine at university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学学习医学。
words.en: Medicine is the science or practice of the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of disease.

words.tr:
v. 检查；核对；
n. 检查；支票；阻止；
words.ex: Please check your homework before class.
words.ex_cn: 请在上课前检查你的作业。
words.en: To examine something in order to determine its accuracy, quality, or condition, or to make sure that something is correct or safe.

words.ex: The doctor prescribed medicine for my cold.
words.ex_cn: 医生给我开了治疗感冒的药。
words.en: If a doctor prescribes medicine or treatment for you, he or she tells you what medicine or treatment to have.

words.ex: This app is pay-to-use.
words.ex_cn: 这个应用程序是付费使用的。
words.en: Requiring payment for use or access.

words.tr: n. 指令；说明；指示；“instruction”的复数；
words.ex: Follow the instructions on the box.
words.ex_cn: 按照盒子上的指令操作。
words.en: Instructions are detailed information about how to do something, especially how to use a piece of equipment or perform a task.

words.ex: The doctor adjusted the dosage of the medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生调整了药物的剂量。
words.en: The amount of a medicine or drug that is taken at one time or over a period of time.

words.ex: The doctor checked his daily intake of sugar.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了他每天的糖摄入量。
words.en: The process of taking something in, especially food, air, or information.

words.ex: The doctor gave me antibiotics for my infection.
words.ex_cn: 医生给我开了抗生素来治疗感染。
words.en: Antibiotics are medicines that are used to treat infections caused by bacteria.

words.ex: The medicine has a side effect of dizziness.
words.ex_cn: 这种药有头晕的副作用。
words.en: An effect of a drug or chemical that is in addition to its intended effect, especially an effect that is harmful or unpleasant.

words.ex: He took a painkiller for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一片止痛药来缓解头痛。
words.en: A painkiller is a drug that reduces or removes physical pain.

words.ex: He took a pill for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一粒药丸来缓解头痛。
words.en: A pill is a small solid mass of medicine that you swallow whole.

words.tr: n. 平板电脑；（刻有文字的）匾；
words.ex: He uses a tablet to read books.
words.ex_cn: 他用平板电脑读书。
words.en: A tablet is a small, flat computer that is controlled by touching the screen. It can also refer to a small, solid piece of medicine that you swallow.

words.ex: He took a capsule for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一粒胶囊来缓解头痛。
words.en: A capsule is a small container or case, especially one that is sealed and contains a dose of medicine, or a spacecraft's compartment for astronauts.

words.ex: He put ointment on his cut.
words.ex_cn: 他把药膏涂在伤口上。
words.en: A smooth substance that is rubbed on the skin to heal wounds or soothe pain.

words.ex: The recipe calls for a mixture of flour and water.
words.ex_cn: 这个食谱需要一种面粉和水的混合物。
words.en: A mixture is a substance made by combining other substances together.

words.ex: He uses eye drops when his eyes are itchy.
words.ex_cn: 当他的眼睛发痒时，他会使用眼药水。
words.en: A liquid medicine that is administered into the eyes to treat various eye conditions or to moisturize dry eyes.

words.ex: He poured syrup on his pancakes.
words.ex_cn: 他把糖浆倒在煎饼上。
words.en: A thick, sweet liquid made by dissolving sugar in boiling water, often used as a topping for desserts or as a sweetener in drinks.

words.tr:
n. 垫；爪垫；便笺簿
v. 放轻脚步走
words.ex: She put a pad on the chair for comfort.
words.ex_cn: 她在椅子上放了一个垫子以增加舒适感。
words.en: A pad is a flat piece of material that is used to protect something, to make something more comfortable, or to absorb liquid.

words.ex: The doctor took an x-ray to check his broken bone.
words.ex_cn: 医生拍了一张X光片来检查他断裂的骨头。
words.en: A type of electromagnetic radiation used for medical imaging, often written with a hyphen.

words.ex: Eating fruits gives you vitamin C.
words.ex_cn: 吃水果可以给你维生素C。
words.en: A vitamin is one of a group of organic substances which are essential in small quantities to the nutrition of most animals and some plants, and which are present in natural foodstuffs or sometimes produced within the body.

words.tr: n. 阿司匹林（镇痛解热消炎药）
words.ex: He took aspirin for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了阿司匹林来缓解头痛。
words.en: Aspirin is a common drug that is used to reduce pain and inflammation.

words.ex: The doctor gave him penicillin for his infection.
words.ex_cn: 医生给他开了青霉素治疗感染。
words.en: An antibiotic drug obtained from molds or produced synthetically, used to treat infections caused by bacteria.

words.ex: He took a cold cure for his runny nose.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了感冒药来缓解流鼻涕。
words.en: A treatment or remedy for the common cold.

words.tr: v. 接种疫苗；预防接种
words.ex: The doctor will vaccinate the child tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 医生明天会给这个孩子接种疫苗。
words.en: To vaccinate someone is to give them a vaccine, usually by injection, to prevent them from getting a disease.

words.ex: The ambulance arrived quickly to help the injured man.
words.ex_cn: 救护车迅速到达以帮助受伤的男人。
words.en: An ambulance is a vehicle equipped to transport the sick or injured, especially to a hospital.

words.ex: The solution to the problem is simple.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题的解决办法很简单。
words.en: A solution to a problem is a way of dealing with it so that the difficulty is removed.

words.ex: He works at a small pharmacy near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他在公园附近的一家小药房工作。
words.en: A pharmacy is a shop or a department in a shop where medicines are prepared and sold.

words.ex: He bought medicine at the chemist's.
words.ex_cn: 他在药房买了药。
words.en: A chemist's is a shop where medicines and other health-related products are sold, and where prescriptions can be filled.

words.ex: He bought medicine at the drug store.
words.ex_cn: 他在药店买了药。
words.en: A drug store is a retail shop where medicine and other articles are sold.

words.ex: The doctor gave him proper treatment for the infection.
words.ex_cn: 医生给他提供了针对感染的适当治疗。
words.en: The act or manner of treating someone or something, especially in a medical context.

words.ex: He is receiving therapy for his back pain.
words.ex_cn: 他正在接受治疗以缓解背痛。
words.en: Therapy is the treatment of someone with mental or physical illness without the use of drugs or operations.

words.ex: He tried acupuncture to relieve his back pain.
words.ex_cn: 他尝试针刺疗法来缓解背痛。
words.en: Acupuncture is a form of treatment that involves inserting very thin needles through a person's skin at specific points on the body, to various depths, for therapeutic purposes.

words.ex: He uses homeopathy to treat his cold.
words.ex_cn: 他用顺势疗法治疗感冒。
words.en: Homeopathy is a system of alternative medicine created in 1796 by Samuel Hahnemann, based on his doctrine of like cures like, a claim that a substance that causes the symptoms of a disease in healthy people would cure similar symptoms in sick people.

words.ex: The doctor checked the vein in his arm.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了他手臂上的静脉。
words.en: A vein is a tube in your body that carries blood towards your heart. It can also refer to a thin layer of a mineral in rock, or a particular style or mood in writing or speech.

words.ex: The doctor gave him an injection for the pain.
words.ex_cn: 医生给他打了一针来缓解疼痛。
words.en: An injection is the act of putting a liquid, especially a drug, into a person's body using a needle and a syringe.

words.ex: He checked the thermometer to see the temperature.
words.ex_cn: 他看了温度计来查看温度。
words.en: A thermometer is an instrument for measuring and indicating temperature.

words.ex: She picked up a needle to sew the button.
words.ex_cn: 她拿起一根针来缝纽扣。
words.en: A needle is a thin, pointed piece of metal that is used in sewing. It has a hole at one end for thread to pass through.

words.tr:
n. 病房；病室；选区；
v. 监护；守护；挡住；
words.ex: The patient is in ward 5.
words.ex_cn: 病人在5号病房。
words.en: A ward is a separate room in a hospital, typically one allocated to a particular type of patient, or a person, especially a child, who is under the protection or care of a legal guardian or a court.

words.tr:
n. 绷带
v. 用绷带包扎
words.ex: He put a bandage on his cut finger.
words.ex_cn: 他在他割伤的手指上贴了绷带。
words.en: A bandage is a piece of material used to cover a wound or to support an injured part of the body.

words.ex: The operation of the machine is very smooth.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器的运行非常顺畅。
words.en: An operation is a planned activity involving many people performing various tasks.

words.ex: The doctor read the patient's case history.
words.ex_cn: 医生阅读了病人的病历。
words.en: A detailed account of a person's medical background or a record of the development of a particular situation or condition over time.

words.ex: His metabolism is very fast.
words.ex_cn: 他的新陈代谢非常快。
words.en: Metabolism is the set of life-sustaining chemical transformations within the cells of living organisms.

words.ex: He hurt his ligament while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时拉伤了韧带。
words.en: A ligament is a band of strong tissue in a person's body which connects bones.

words.ex: He stepped on my heel by accident.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心踩到了我的脚后跟。
words.en: The heel is the back part of the foot, below the ankle. It can also refer to the part of a shoe or boot that supports this part of the foot.

words.tr: n. 单元格；细胞；牢房；小房间；
words.ex: Each cell in the spreadsheet holds a number.
words.ex_cn: 电子表格中的每个单元格都包含一个数字。
words.en: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of an organism, typically microscopic and consisting of cytoplasm and a nucleus enclosed in a membrane. It can also refer to a small room in which a prisoner is locked up or a device for producing electricity from chemical reactions.

words.ex: Bacteria can make you sick.
words.ex_cn: 细菌会让你生病。
words.en: Bacteria are very small organisms. Some bacteria can cause diseases.

words.ex: The government wants to improve healthcare for everyone.
words.ex_cn: 政府希望为所有人改善医疗保健。
words.en: Healthcare refers to the organized provision of medical care to individuals or a community.

words.ex: He strengthened his muscle by lifting weights.
words.ex_cn: 他通过举重来增强肌肉。
words.en: Muscle is the tissue in the body that can contract to produce movement or maintain the position of parts of the body.

words.ex: The cardiac patient needs to rest daily.
words.ex_cn: 这位心脏病人需要每天休息。
words.en: Cardiac means relating to the heart.

words.tr: phrase. 职业因素；与工作相关的各种条件或要素（如工作环境、任务要求、暴露风险等）
words.ex: Heavy lifting is an occupational factor for truck drivers.
words.ex_cn: 重物搬运是卡车司机的职业因素。
words.en: Occupational factors refer to the various elements related to one's job or profession that can influence their health, well-being, and performance.

words.tr: phrase. 工作时间不规律；从事非固定工时的工作
words.ex: He is working irregular hours at the hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他在医院工作时间不规律。
words.en: Working hours that do not follow a regular or predictable pattern, often varying from day to day or week to week.

words.ex: He got a sports injury while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时受了运动损伤。
words.en: An injury that occurs as a result of participating in sports or physical activities.

words.tr: phrase. 对自身身体的无知；对自身身体的忽视
words.ex: His ignorance of their body led to poor health choices.
words.ex_cn: 他对自身身体的无知导致了不健康的饮食选择。
words.en: Lack of knowledge or awareness about one's own physical condition or anatomy.

words.tr: phrase. 预期寿命；平均寿命
words.ex: Life expectancy has increased in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 许多国家的预期寿命已经增加。
words.en: The average period that a person may expect to live.

words.tr: phrase. 生物钟紊乱；内部时钟失调
words.ex: He has an internal clock disorder that makes him sleep at wrong times.
words.ex_cn: 他有一种生物钟紊乱，导致他在错误的时间睡觉。
words.en: A condition characterized by the misalignment of the body's internal clock with the external environment, leading to irregular sleep-wake cycles.

words.tr: phrase. 非正常社交时间；指在大多数人休息或社交活动之外的工作时段（如深夜、清晨或周末）
words.ex: He works unsocial hours every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都上夜班。
words.en: Unsocial hours refer to hours outside the standard working day, such as nights, weekends, or holidays, when most people are not working and are engaging in social or leisure activities.

words.tr: phrase. 家庭问题；家庭内部的矛盾或困扰
words.ex: He feels sad because of family problems.
words.ex_cn: 他因为家庭问题感到难过。
words.en: Issues or conflicts within a family that can affect the emotional well-being and relationships of its members.

words.tr: phrase. 高压的；需要快速决策和高强度工作的
words.ex: He works under high pressure every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都在高压下工作。
words.en: High pressure refers to a condition of the atmosphere in which the atmospheric pressure is higher than that of surrounding areas, often associated with clear weather.

words.tr: phrase. 不健康的生活方式
words.ex: He has an unhealthy lifestyle because he eats fast food every day.
words.ex_cn: 他有一个不健康的生活方式，因为他每天都吃快餐。
words.en: A way of living that lowers the quality of life and increases the risk of disease, often characterized by poor diet, lack of exercise, and harmful habits.

words.tr: phrase. 压力管理；应对压力的技巧与方法
words.ex: He practices yoga for stress management.
words.ex_cn: 他练习瑜伽来管理压力。
words.en: Stress management refers to the wide spectrum of techniques and psychotherapies aimed at controlling a person's levels of stress, especially chronic stress, usually for the purpose of improving everyday functioning.

words.ex: Her mornings are hectic with work and kids.
words.ex_cn: 她的早晨因为工作和孩子而紧张忙碌。
words.en: If you describe a situation as hectic, you mean that it is very busy and involves a lot of rushed activity.

words.tr: adj. 焦虑的；渴望的；担忧的；
words.ex: He feels anxious before every test.
words.ex_cn: 他每次考试前都感到焦虑。
words.en: If you are anxious to do something or anxious that something should happen, you very much want to do it or very much want it to happen.

words.tr: adj. 抑郁的； v. 降低；“depress”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He felt depressed after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到抑郁。
words.en: If you are depressed, you are sad and feel that you cannot enjoy anything, because your situation is so difficult and unpleasant.

words.tr: adj. 紧张不安的；神经系统的；
words.ex: He felt nervous before the test.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试前感到紧张不安。
words.en: If someone is nervous, they are frightened or worried about something that is happening or might happen, and show this in their behavior.

words.ex: He went to the clinic for a check-up.
words.ex_cn: 他去诊所做检查。
words.en: A clinic is a place where people receive medical treatment or advice, especially for a particular illness or condition.

words.ex: He visits the dentist every six months.
words.ex_cn: 他每六个月去看一次牙医。
words.en: A dentist is a person who is qualified to treat diseases and conditions that affect the teeth and gums, especially the repair and extraction of teeth and the insertion of artificial ones.

words.tr:
n. 练习；实践；惯常做法；
v. 从事；练习；
words.ex: Daily practice helps you improve your skills.
words.ex_cn: 每天的练习帮助你提高技能。
words.en: Practice is the act of rehearsing a behavior over and over, or engaging in an activity again and again, for the purpose of improving or mastering it, as in the phrase 'practice makes perfect'.

words.ex: He visits his general practitioner for a check-up.
words.ex_cn: 他去看全科医生做体检。
words.en: A general practitioner is a doctor who does not specialize in one particular area of medicine, but who has a medical practice in which he or she treats all types of illness.
