words.ex: The surgeon fixed the broken bone.
words.ex_cn: 外科医生修复了断裂的骨头。
words.en: A surgeon is a medical doctor who performs operations.

words.ex: The physician checked the patient's temperature.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了病人的体温。
words.en: A physician is a medical doctor who is trained in the diagnosis and treatment of diseases and injuries.

words.tr:
n. 兽医；
v. 审查；
words.ex: The vet checked the dog's health.
words.ex_cn: 兽医检查了狗的健康状况。
words.en: A vet is a person who is qualified to treat sick or injured animals. As a verb, to vet means to examine something or someone carefully to make sure they are suitable for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He works at a veterinary clinic.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家兽医诊所工作。
words.en: Relating to the medical or surgical treatment of animals, especially domesticated animals.

words.ex: The oculist checked my eyes for glasses.
words.ex_cn: 眼科医生为我检查了眼睛以配眼镜。
words.en: A doctor who specializes in the treatment of eye diseases.

words.ex: He had a check-up at the hospital last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周在医院做了体检。
words.en: A check-up is a medical examination by your doctor to make sure that there is nothing wrong with your health.

words.ex: The doctor made a diagnosis after checking the symptoms.
words.ex_cn: 医生在检查了症状后做出了诊断。
words.en: The identification of the nature of an illness or other problem by examination of the symptoms.

words.ex: The doctor wrote a prescription for medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生开了一张药方。
words.en: A prescription is a written order from a physician for the preparation and administration of a drug or device for a patient.

words.ex: The virus made many people sick.
words.ex_cn: 这个病毒让很多人病了。
words.en: A virus is a very small organism that causes infectious diseases in people, animals, and plants.

words.ex: He had a consultation with the doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他与医生进行了一次咨询。
words.en: A consultation is a meeting which is held to discuss something. Consultation is discussion about something that is still being planned.

words.ex: His eyesight is getting worse with age.
words.ex_cn: 他的视力随着年龄增长而变差。
words.en: Your eyesight is your ability to see.

words.tr: phrase. 诊所区域；医疗诊区
words.ex: The clinic area is clean and quiet.
words.ex_cn: 诊所区域干净又安静。
words.en: A clinic area refers to a designated space within a healthcare facility where medical consultations and treatments are provided to patients.

words.tr: phrase. 门诊部：医院中为未住院的患者提供诊断和治疗服务的部门。
words.ex: He went to the out-patient department for a check-up.
words.ex_cn: 他去门诊部做检查。
words.en: A department in a hospital where patients receive diagnosis or treatment without being admitted to the hospital.

words.tr: phrase. 门诊部实验室；门诊化验室
words.ex: The doctor sent him to the OPD laboratory for a blood test.
words.ex_cn: 医生让他去门诊实验室做血液检查。
words.en: An outpatient department (OPD) laboratory is a facility within a hospital or clinic where medical tests are conducted on samples from patients who are not admitted to the hospital.

words.tr: phrase. 门诊注射；在门诊进行的注射治疗
words.ex: He got an outpatient injection at the clinic.
words.ex_cn: 他在诊所接受了门诊注射。
words.en: An outpatient injection refers to the administration of medication or vaccines via injection to patients who visit a hospital or clinic for treatment without being admitted overnight.

words.tr: phrase. 诊室；诊疗室（医生或牙医等与病人会面并进行诊断的房间）
words.ex: The doctor works in a small consulting room.
words.ex_cn: 医生在一个小诊室工作。
words.en: A consulting room is a room in which a professional person, such as a doctor, lawyer, or business consultant, meets clients or patients.

words.tr: phrase. 试点计划；小规模试验项目
words.ex: The city started a pilot scheme to reduce traffic.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市启动了一项减少交通的试点计划。
words.en: A small-scale trial project to test its feasibility.

words.ex: They bury the dead in the cemetery.
words.ex_cn: 他们把死者埋葬在墓地里。
words.en: To bury something means to put it into a hole in the ground and cover it up, often in order to hide it or to put it to rest.

words.tr: n. 噩梦；不愉快的经历；
words.ex: He had a nightmare about falling from a tall building.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一个从高楼坠落的噩梦。
words.en: A nightmare is a very frightening dream.

words.tr: adj. 残疾的； v. “disable”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The disabled man uses a wheelchair to move around.
words.ex_cn: 这位残疾人使用轮椅行动。
words.en: If someone is disabled, they are unable to use part of their body or mind properly, for example, because of injury or illness.

words.ex: The currency in Japan is the yen.
words.ex_cn: 日本的货币是日元。
words.en: The system of money in general use in a particular country.

words.tr:
n. 基金；资金；
v. 提供资金；
words.ex: The school raised a fund for new books.
words.ex_cn: 学校为购买新书筹集了一笔基金。
words.en: A sum of money saved or made available for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He paid one dollar for the apple.
words.ex_cn: 他花了一美元买这个苹果。
words.en: The dollar is the unit of money used in the United States, Canada, Australia, and some other countries.

words.ex: The book costs five pounds.
words.ex_cn: 这本书五英镑。
words.en: The pound is the unit of money used in Britain. It is also a unit of weight equal to 16 ounces or 0.4536 kilograms. As a verb, to pound means to hit something hard many times or to crush something into a powder or paste.

words.ex: He paid 1000 yen for the sushi.
words.ex_cn: 他用一千日元买了寿司。
words.en: The yen is the unit of currency used in Japan. It can also mean a strong desire or craving for something.

words.ex: He paid five euros for the coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他花了五欧元买咖啡。
words.en: The euro is the official currency of the Eurozone, which consists of 19 of the 27 member states of the European Union.

words.tr: phrase. 便士（英国货币单位）；少量的钱
words.ex: He found a penny on the ground.
words.ex_cn: 他在地上找到一枚便士。
words.en: A British coin worth one hundredth of a pound; the plural is 'pence'.

words.ex: The apple costs 50 cents.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果售价50分。
words.en: A cent is a small unit of money in many countries. In the United States, a cent is equal to one hundredth of a dollar.

words.tr:
n. 硬币；金属钱币；
v. 创造；
words.ex: He has a coin in his pocket.
words.ex_cn: 他口袋里有一枚硬币。
words.en: A coin is a small, flat, round piece of metal or plastic that is used as money.

words.ex: The coin is made of nickel.
words.ex_cn: 这枚硬币是镍制的。
words.en: A hard silver-white metal that is used in making alloys and is a chemical element. It is also a coin worth five cents in the US and Canada.

words.ex: He found a dime on the ground.
words.ex_cn: 他在地上找到一枚一角硬币。
words.en: A dime is a coin worth ten cents, one tenth of a United States dollar.

words.ex: This box weighs one unit.
words.ex_cn: 这个箱子重一单位。
words.en: A unit is a single thing or person that is part of something larger.

words.ex: This book is worth five dollars because it has great value.
words.ex_cn: 这本书值五美元，因为它很有价值。
words.en: The importance, usefulness, or merit of something.

words.ex: There are many denominations in Christianity.
words.ex_cn: 基督教中有许多宗派。
words.en: A denomination is a recognized autonomous branch of the Christian Church or a unit of value, especially in currency.

words.tr: phrase. 票面价值；表面价值
words.ex: The coin has a face value of one dollar.
words.ex_cn: 这枚硬币的面值是一美元。
words.en: The apparent worth or implication of something, based on initial impression or without deeper analysis.

words.tr: 短语，意为‘每百个中有四个’，表示比例或概率
words.ex: Four in hundred students like math.
words.ex_cn: 一百个学生中有四个喜欢数学。
words.en: A phrase meaning 4 out of 100, or 4%, used to express a small proportion or percentage.

words.tr: phrase. 把钱换成五元面额
words.ex: He gave the money in fives to the cashier.
words.ex_cn: 他用五元钞票把钱给了收银员。
words.en: To provide cash in denominations of five units (e.g., five-dollar bills).

words.tr:
n. 变化；变革；
v. 变化；变革；
words.ex: There was a big change in the weather.
words.ex_cn: 天气发生了很大的变化。
words.en: To make or become different; to alter or modify; to exchange or replace something with another.

words.ex: He paid with cash for the bread.
words.ex_cn: 他用现金买了面包。
words.en: Money in the form of coins or banknotes, especially that which is immediately available.

words.ex: He uses a credit card to buy food.
words.ex_cn: 他用信用卡买食物。
words.en: A credit card is a small plastic card that you use to buy things on credit or to borrow money.

words.tr: phrase. 透支；透支额度（指银行账户余额为负的情况或允许的透支金额）
words.ex: He got an overdraft because he spent more than his bank balance.
words.ex_cn: 他因为花的钱超过了银行余额而发生了透支。
words.en: To withdraw more money from a bank account than is available, resulting in a negative balance.

words.tr: phrase. 密码代码；用于验证身份的密码组合
words.ex: He forgot his password code and couldn't log in.
words.ex_cn: 他忘记了密码代码，无法登录。
words.en: A secret word or phrase used to gain access to a computer system or service.

words.ex: He sent the payment by money order.
words.ex_cn: 他通过汇票支付了款项。
words.en: A money order is a printed order for payment of a specified sum, issued by a bank or post office.

words.tr:
v. 检查；核对；
n. 检查；支票；阻止；
words.ex: Please check your homework before class.
words.ex_cn: 请在上课前检查你的作业。
words.en: To examine something in order to determine its accuracy, quality, or condition, or to make sure that something is correct or safe.

words.ex: I paid the electric bill yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天付了电费账单。
words.en: A bill is a statement of money owed for goods or services, a proposed law presented to a legislature for approval, a piece of paper money, or the beak of a bird.

words.tr: phrase. 记名支票；抬头支票（需由指定收款人背书后方可兑现的支票）
words.ex: He paid with an order check to ensure the money went to the right person.
words.ex_cn: 他用一张记名支票付款，以确保钱给了正确的人。
words.en: A verification process to confirm that an order has been placed correctly, often used in retail or logistics.

words.ex: He gave me a rubber check last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周给了我一张空头支票。
words.en: A check that cannot be cashed because there are insufficient funds in the account.

words.ex: He gave her a blank check to buy whatever she needed.
words.ex_cn: 他给了她一张空头支票，让她买任何需要的东西。
words.en: A blank check is a signed check with the amount left blank, to be filled in by the payee, or metaphorically, complete freedom to act as one wishes.

words.ex: He checks his bank book every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周都会查看他的存折。
words.en: A bank book is a small book in which a bank customer's transactions are recorded.

words.ex: He checked his pass book to see his savings.
words.ex_cn: 他查看了存折来看他的储蓄。
words.en: A small booklet issued by a bank, recording deposits, withdrawals, and the current balance of a savings account.

words.ex: He wants to open an account at the bank.
words.ex_cn: 他想在银行开一个账户。
words.en: To open an account means to establish a new account with a bank or other financial institution where money can be deposited, withdrawn, or managed.

words.tr: phrase. 两人共有的银行账户；联合账户
words.ex: They have a joint account for their rent and groceries.
words.ex_cn: 他们有一个共同账户用于支付房租和杂货。
words.en: A joint account is a bank account shared by two or more individuals, typically used for managing shared expenses or assets.

words.tr: phrase. 活期存款帐户；活期存折；来往户头
words.ex: He checks his current account every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周检查他的活期账户。
words.en: A current account is a type of bank account that allows you to deposit and withdraw money frequently, and often comes with a cheque book and a debit card.

words.ex: He deposits money into his cheque account.
words.ex_cn: 他把钱存入他的支票账户。
words.en: A cheque account is a bank account that allows you to write cheques to pay for goods and services.

words.tr: phrase. 定期存款账户；储蓄存款账户
words.ex: He put his savings into a deposit account.
words.ex_cn: 他把积蓄存入了一个定期存款账户。
words.en: A deposit account is a bank account that earns interest and allows you to deposit and withdraw money, but typically does not come with a checkbook or debit card.

words.tr: phrase. 费用账户；报销账户（指公司为员工支付业务开销的账户）
words.ex: He uses his expense account for business trips.
words.ex_cn: 他用业务报销账户支付差旅费用。
words.en: An expense account is a financial arrangement that allows an employee to spend money on behalf of the company, with the costs being reimbursed by the company.

words.tr: phrase. 即时账户；可立即开通并使用的账户
words.ex: He opened an instant account online.
words.ex_cn: 他在线上开设了一个即时账户。
words.en: An instant account is a type of bank account that can be opened quickly, often online, and allows for immediate use without the need for a lengthy application process.

words.ex: The restaurant added a service charge to the bill.
words.ex_cn: 餐厅在账单上加了一笔服务费。
words.en: A service charge is an amount of money that is added to your bill in a restaurant or hotel, to pay for the service you have received.

words.tr:
n. 出纳员，收银员
v. 革除（军职）
words.ex: The cashier counted the money at the end of the day.
words.ex_cn: 收银员在一天结束时清点了钱。
words.en: A cashier is a person whose job is to receive and pay out money in a shop, bank, or business.

words.tr: n. 讲述者；（银行）出纳员；
words.ex: The old man is the teller of fairy tales.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人是童话故事的讲述者。
words.en: A teller is a person who works in a bank and whose job includes receiving and paying out money.

words.ex: The company made a statement about the new policy.
words.ex_cn: 公司就新政策发布了一项声明。
words.en: A statement is something that you say or write which gives information in a formal or definite way.

words.ex: He wants to apply for a job at the library.
words.ex_cn: 他想申请图书馆的工作。
words.en: To make a formal request, usually in writing, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 授予贷款；同意借出款项
words.ex: The bank will grant a loan to the small business.
words.ex_cn: 银行将向这家小企业发放贷款。
words.en: To agree to give someone a sum of money that they must pay back, usually with interest.

words.tr:
adj. 贸易的；商业的；
n. 广告；
words.ex: The commercial ship sailed to another country.
words.ex_cn: 这艘贸易船只驶向了另一个国家。
words.en: Commercial relates to the business of buying and selling goods and services.

words.ex: The merchant bank gave a loan to the small business.
words.ex_cn: 商业银行向这家小企业提供了贷款。
words.en: A merchant bank is a bank that deals mostly in (but is not limited to) international finance, long-term loans for companies and underwriting. Merchant banks do not provide regular banking services to the general public.

words.ex: He got a full refund for the broken phone.
words.ex_cn: 他因为坏了的手机得到了全额退款。
words.en: A full refund is the return of the entire amount of money paid for a product or service, typically due to dissatisfaction or defect.

words.ex: I draw money from the bank every week.
words.ex_cn: 我每周从银行提取钱。
words.en: To make a picture, pattern, or diagram by making lines and marks, especially with a pen or pencil, on paper.

words.ex: He withdrew $100 from the ATM.
words.ex_cn: 他从自动取款机里提取了100美元。
words.en: If you withdraw something from a place, you remove it or take it away.

words.ex: You need to pay a 40-yuan deposit to rent the bike.
words.ex_cn: 租自行车需要支付40元押金。
words.en: A deposit is a sum of money which is part of the full price of something, and which you pay when you agree to buy it. It is also a sum of money that you pay into a bank account.

words.tr: phrase. 赚取利息；获得收益
words.ex: He puts money in the bank to earn interest.
words.ex_cn: 他把钱存在银行里以赚取利息。
words.en: To receive interest on money that you have invested or deposited in a bank account.

words.ex: The bank raised the interest rate last month.
words.ex_cn: 银行上个月提高了利率。
words.en: The interest rate is the percentage of an amount of money which is paid for its use for a specified time, usually expressed as an annual percentage rate.

words.ex: The exchange rate is high today.
words.ex_cn: 今天的汇率很高。
words.en: The exchange rate is the rate at which one currency will be exchanged for another. It is also regarded as the value of one country's currency in relation to another currency.

words.tr: phrase. 折扣率的；享受折扣的价格
words.ex: The hotel offers a discounted rate for students.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店为学生提供折扣价。
words.en: A discounted rate is a reduced price or cost that is offered for a product or service, often as an incentive for early purchase, bulk buying, or other conditions.

words.tr: phrase. 用数字表示的金额；以阿拉伯数字书写的数额
words.ex: The amount in figures is 500 dollars.
words.ex_cn: 用数字表示的金额是500美元。
words.en: The numerical representation of a sum of money.

words.tr: 短语. 用文字表示的金额；大写金额
words.ex: She wrote the amount in words on the check.
words.ex_cn: 她在支票上用文字写了金额。
words.en: The sum of money or quantity expressed in written words rather than numerals, as used in legal or formal documents to prevent fraud.

words.w: the balance of your bank account
words.tr: phrase. 你银行账户的余额
words.uk: ðə ˈbæləns əv jɔː(r) bæŋk əˈkaʊnt
words.us: ðə ˈbæləns əv jʊr bæŋk əˈkaʊnt
words.ex: The balance of your bank account is low.
words.ex_cn: 你的银行账户余额很低。
words.en: The amount of money currently available in a bank account.

words.ex: I withdrew cash from the atm near the bank.
words.ex_cn: 我在银行附近的自动取款机取了现金。
words.en: An ATM is a machine that allows people to take out money from their bank accounts by using a special card. ATM can also refer to Asynchronous Transfer Mode, a telecommunications concept defined by ANSI and ITU (formerly CCITT) standards for carriage of a complete range of user traffic, including voice, data, and video signals.

words.ex: He used the cash machine to get money.
words.ex_cn: 他使用取款机取钱。
words.en: A cash machine is a machine, usually in a wall outside a bank, from which you can take money out of your bank account using a special card.

words.tr: n. 崩溃；故障；细目分类；
words.ex: The stress led to a breakdown.
words.ex_cn: 压力导致了崩溃。
words.en: A breakdown is a failure of a system, machine, or relationship, or a sudden collapse in someone's mental health.

words.ex: He took out a mortgage to buy his first house.
words.ex_cn: 他申请了一笔抵押贷款来购买他的第一套房子。
words.en: A mortgage is a loan of money which you get from a bank or building society in order to buy a house.

words.ex: He gets his money on payday.
words.ex_cn: 他在发薪日拿到工资。
words.en: The day on which someone receives their wages or salary.

words.ex: He checked his pay slip on Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他在周五查看了工资单。
words.en: A pay slip is a document given to an employee each time they are paid, detailing the amount of money earned and any deductions.

words.ex: He envelops the gift in colorful paper.
words.ex_cn: 他用彩色纸把礼物包起来。
words.en: To wrap up, cover, or surround completely.

words.ex: He bought the car by installment.
words.ex_cn: 他分期付款买了这辆车。
words.en: By installment means paying for something in parts over a period of time rather than paying the full amount at once.

words.ex: He paid off his debt last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月还清了债务。
words.en: A debt is a sum of money that you owe someone.

words.ex: The loan requires collateral documents.
words.ex_cn: 这笔贷款需要附属文件。
words.en: Collateral is something pledged as security for repayment of a loan, to be forfeited in the event of a default.

words.ex: Please fill out this form before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 请在离开前填写这张表格。
words.en: To complete a form or document by providing the required information.

words.ex: He has dyed hair in blue.
words.ex_cn: 他的头发染成了蓝色。
words.en: Hair that has been colored with dye.

words.tr:
n. 染料；
v. 给...染色；
words.ex: She bought a natural dye to color her fabric.
words.ex_cn: 她买了一种天然染料来给布料染色。
words.en: A dye is a substance used to change the color of something permanently. To dye something means to change its color by applying a dye.

words.ex: The blond man smiled at the children.
words.ex_cn: 那个白肤金发的男子对孩子们微笑了。
words.en: If someone has blond hair, it is pale yellow in color.

words.ex: The golden sun set behind the hills.
words.ex_cn: 金色的太阳在山后落下。
words.en: Something that is golden is bright yellow in color, like gold. It can also describe something that is very good or valuable.

words.ex: The girl has fair hair and blue eyes.
words.ex_cn: 这个女孩有一头金发和蓝色的眼睛。
words.en: Light-colored hair, typically blonde.

words.ex: He has grey hair at age 50.
words.ex_cn: 他50岁时就有了灰发。
words.en: Hair that has turned grey or white, typically as a result of aging.

words.tr:
adj. 褐色的；棕色的；
n. 褐色；棕色；
words.ex: The brown dog slept on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 那只褐色的狗躺在地板上睡觉。
words.en: Brown is a color that is a mixture of red, yellow, and black. It is the color of earth, wood, and many other natural things.

words.tr: n. 女孩垂在头两侧编或不编成辫子的长发，发辫，辫子
words.ex: The girl has two pigtails on her head.
words.ex_cn: 这个女孩头上扎着两条辫子。
words.en: A pigtail is a length of hair that is tied together at the back of the head or at each side of the head so that it hangs down like a tail.

words.ex: She wears her hair in a ponytail.
words.ex_cn: 她把头发扎成马尾辫。
words.en: A hairstyle in which the hair is pulled back and tied at the back of the head, resembling the tail of a pony.

words.tr:
n. 离别；分别；分界线；分界处
adj. 离别时的；逝去的
v. 分离；分开；“part”的现在分词
words.ex: He said goodbye with a sad parting smile.
words.ex_cn: 他带着悲伤的告别微笑说了再见。
words.en: The act of leaving or separating from someone or something.

words.ex: He ate a bun for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了一个面包卷。
words.en: A bun is a small, usually round piece of bread. It can also refer to a hairstyle in which the hair is gathered into a tight coil or knot at the back of the head.

words.tr: phrase. 发夹；用于固定头发的小型U形金属或塑料夹子
words.ex: She stuck the hair pin into her hair to keep it tidy.
words.ex_cn: 她把发夹插进头发里以保持整齐。
words.en: A hair pin is a small piece of metal or plastic bent into a U-shape, used to hold a woman's hair in place.

words.tr:
adj. 粉红色的；
n. 粉红色；
words.ex: The flower is pink.
words.ex_cn: 这朵花是粉红色的。
words.en: Pink is a pale red color that is named after the flower of the same name. It is often associated with femininity and romance.

words.ex: He rubbed his chin when he thought.
words.ex_cn: 他思考时摸了摸下巴。
words.en: The part of the face below the mouth and above the neck.

words.ex: He has a scar on his arm from the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他手臂上有一道事故留下的伤疤。
words.en: A mark left on the skin after a wound or injury has healed, or the act of causing such a mark.

words.tr: phrase. 红润的脸颊；红扑扑的脸蛋
words.ex: The child has red cheeks from the cold wind.
words.ex_cn: 孩子因为寒风而脸颊发红。
words.en: Red cheeks refer to the cheeks that appear red or flushed, often due to embarrassment, excitement, or health.

words.tr: phrase. 胡须和小胡子（指男性面部生长的下巴胡须与上唇小胡子的组合）
words.ex: He grew a beard and moustache to look older.
words.ex_cn: 他留了胡须和小胡子，看起来更年长。
words.en: A beard and moustache combined, often referring to facial hair on a man's face.

words.tr: adj. 胡子刮光的，无胡子的，不蓄须的
words.ex: He is clean-shaven every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都刮得干干净净。
words.en: Having a face that is smooth because all the hair has been shaved off.

words.tr:
n. 皱纹
v. 起皱纹；弄皱…
words.ex: He has a deep wrinkle on his forehead.
words.ex_cn: 他的额头上有一道深深的皱纹。
words.en: A wrinkle is a small line or fold in something, especially fabric or the skin.

words.tr:
n. 雀斑；小斑点
v. （使）生雀斑
words.ex: He has freckles on his nose.
words.ex_cn: 他的鼻子上有雀斑。
words.en: A freckle is a small, brownish spot on the skin, often becoming more pronounced through exposure to the sun.

words.tr: n. 皮肤上的红色小疱
words.ex: He has a small pimple on his nose.
words.ex_cn: 他鼻子上有个小痘痘。
words.en: A pimple is a small raised spot on the skin that is often red and may contain pus.

words.ex: He has a dimple when he smiles.
words.ex_cn: 他笑的时候有一个酒窝。
words.en: A dimple is a small natural indentation in the flesh on a part of the human body, especially one formed in the cheeks when someone smiles.

words.ex: She has excellent night vision.
words.ex_cn: 她有很好的夜视能力。
words.en: Vision is the ability to see, the area that you can see, the ability to imagine how a country, society, industry, etc. could develop in the future and to plan in a suitable way, or an experience in which you see something that is not really there.

words.tr: adj. 滑稽的；好笑的；有趣的；
words.ex: The funny clown made everyone laugh.
words.ex_cn: 那个滑稽的小丑让所有人都笑了。
words.en: Something that is funny is amusing and likely to make you laugh.

words.tr: adj. 有才智的；聪明的；明智的；
words.ex: The intelligent boy solved the math problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这个有才智的男孩很快解出了这道数学题。
words.en: Someone who is intelligent has the ability to think, understand, and learn things quickly and well.

words.ex: He is confident when he speaks in front of the class.
words.ex_cn: 他在全班面前说话时很自信。
words.en: If you are confident, you are certain of your abilities or of your beliefs.

words.tr:
adj. 成熟的；
v. 成熟；
words.ex: He is a mature student who works full-time.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位成熟的学生，全职工作。
words.en: When something or someone matures, they become fully grown or developed. In finance, a mature investment is one that has reached the end of its term and is ready to be paid out.

words.ex: The elderly man walks slowly with a cane.
words.ex_cn: 这位年老的男子拄着拐杖慢慢走。
words.en: An elderly person is someone who is old or aging.

words.tr:
adj. 资深的；高级的；年长的；
n. 年长者；大四学生；
words.ex: He is a senior engineer with 20 years of experience.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有20年经验的资深工程师。
words.en: Higher in rank, status, or importance; older in age.

words.ex: His personality is very friendly and outgoing.
words.ex_cn: 他的个性非常友好和外向。
words.en: The combination of characteristics or qualities that form an individual's distinctive character.

words.ex: His weakness made him unable to fight back.
words.ex_cn: 他的软弱使他无法反击。
words.en: A weakness is a fault or lack of strength in someone's character or in a system, plan, or design.

words.tr: adj. 苗条的；纤细的；微小的；
words.ex: She has a slim figure.
words.ex_cn: 她身材苗条。
words.en: If someone is slim, they are thin in an attractive way.

words.ex: He is a well-built man who lifts weights every day.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个身材健壮的人，每天举重。
words.en: A well-built person or thing is strong and solidly constructed.

words.ex: He is a medium-built man with short hair.
words.ex_cn: 他是个中等身材、短发的男子。
words.en: Having a body of average size and build, neither particularly thin nor heavy.

words.ex: The table is made of sturdy wood.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是用坚固的木头做的。
words.en: Someone or something that is sturdy looks strong and is unlikely to be easily injured or damaged.

words.tr:
adj. 固体的；坚固的；可靠的；
n. 固体；
words.ex: Ice is a solid form of water.
words.ex_cn: 冰是水的固体形式。
words.en: A solid substance or object stays the same shape whether it is in a container or not.

words.ex: The chubby baby laughed loudly.
words.ex_cn: 那个胖乎乎的宝宝大声笑了。
words.en: Someone who is chubby is slightly fat in a way that people often find attractive.

words.tr:
adj. 丰满的；肥胖的
v. （使）圆胖；（使）鼓起
adv. 噗通地；直接地
words.ex: The baby has plump cheeks.
words.ex_cn: 这个婴儿有圆润的脸颊。
words.en: Having a full rounded shape; chubby.

words.ex: He is overweight because he eats too much junk food.
words.ex_cn: 他超重是因为吃太多垃圾食品。
words.en: If someone is overweight, they weigh more than is considered healthy or attractive.

words.ex: The average height of the students is 170 cm.
words.ex_cn: 这些学生的平均身高是170厘米。
words.en: The mean height of a group of people or things, calculated by adding together the heights of all the individuals and dividing by the number of individuals.

words.ex: The old tree has a stout trunk.
words.ex_cn: 这棵老树有一个粗壮的树干。
words.en: Someone who is stout is rather fat or heavy.

words.ex: She has a slender figure.
words.ex_cn: 她身材苗条。
words.en: Someone or something that is slender is thin and graceful.

words.ex: He is a lanky boy who plays basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个瘦高个男孩，打篮球。
words.en: If you describe someone as lanky, you mean that they are tall and thin and move awkwardly.

words.tr: adj. 皮包骨头的；极瘦的；
words.ex: The skinny dog had no meat on its bones.
words.ex_cn: 那只皮包骨头的狗身上一点肉都没有。
words.en: Very thin, especially in a way that is unattractive.

words.tr:
adj. 精瘦的；精简的；不景气的；
v. 倾斜；倚靠；
words.ex: The dog is lean and fast.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗精瘦而敏捷。
words.en: If you lean in a particular direction, you bend your body in that direction. If you lean on or against someone or something, you rest against them so that they partly support your weight. If you describe someone as lean, you mean that they are thin but look strong and healthy. If you describe a period of time as lean, you mean that it is a time when people have very little of something, especially money.

words.tr: adj. 肌肉的；肌肉发达的；
words.ex: He has a muscular arm from lifting weights.
words.ex_cn: 他因为举重而拥有强壮的手臂。
words.en: Relating to or affecting the muscles; having well-developed muscles.

words.tr: adj. 强健的；强壮的；结实的；
words.ex: The dog is robust and runs every day.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗很强健，每天跑步。
words.en: Strong and healthy; vigorous. (of an object) sturdy in construction.

words.ex: She wears a gold earring.
words.ex_cn: 她戴了一只金耳环。
words.en: An earring is a piece of jewelry that you attach to your ear.

words.ex: She wears a gold necklace every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天都戴一条金项链。
words.en: A necklace is a piece of jewellery such as a chain or a string of beads which someone, usually a woman, wears around their neck.

words.ex: She wears a silver bracelet every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天戴一条银手链。
words.en: A bracelet is a piece of jewellery that you wear around your wrist or arm.

words.tr:
v. 给…打电话；响铃；
n. 环；环形物；铃声；拳击场；
words.ex: I will ring you tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天给你打电话。
words.en: A ring is a small circular band, typically of precious metal and often set with one or more gemstones, worn on a finger as an ornament or a token of marriage, engagement, or authority. It can also refer to the act of making a clear resonant or vibrating sound, or to encircle or surround something.

words.ex: She wore a silver brooch on her coat.
words.ex_cn: 她把一枚银色胸针别在外套上。
words.en: A brooch is a piece of jewelry that has a pin at the back so it can be fastened to a dress, blouse, or coat.

words.ex: The boy resembles his father.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩长得像他父亲。
words.en: If one thing or person resembles another, they are similar to each other.

words.ex: The palm tree grows near the beach.
words.ex_cn: 棕榈树长在海滩附近。
words.en: The inner surface of the hand that extends from the wrist to the base of the fingers; also refers to the tropical tree with large divided leaves.

words.ex: He hurt his finger while cooking.
words.ex_cn: 他在做饭时弄伤了手指。
words.en: One of the five long parts at the end of your hand, including your thumb.

words.tr:
n. 脚趾
v. 用脚尖触
words.ex: He touched the ball with his toe.
words.ex_cn: 他用脚趾碰了球。
words.en: One of the five digits at the end of the foot, or the similar part of a shoe or sock.

words.ex: He rubbed his chest after the cough.
words.ex_cn: 他咳嗽后揉了揉胸部。
words.en: The front part of a person's body between the neck and the stomach, or a large strong box used for storing things.

words.ex: The brain controls our thoughts and movements.
words.ex_cn: 大脑控制我们的思想和行动。
words.en: The brain is the organ inside your head that controls your body's activities and enables you to think and to feel things such as heat and pain.

words.ex: All new students must attend the orientation meeting on Monday.
words.ex_cn: 所有新生必须参加周一的新生报到会。
words.en: An orientation meeting is a gathering designed to introduce new members, employees, or students to an organization or institution, providing them with essential information and helping them to adapt to their new environment.

words.tr: phrase. 新生介绍交流之旅；迎新宣讲参观活动
words.ex: The university organized an orientation talking tour for new students.
words.ex_cn: 大学为新生组织了一场新生介绍交流之旅。
words.en: A guided introduction or explanation, often for new students or visitors.

words.ex: His expectation was to pass the test.
words.ex_cn: 他的期待是通过考试。
words.en: An expectation is a belief about what might happen in the future, especially about something that you think is likely or that you hope will happen.

words.ex: The opening ceremony was colorful and loud.
words.ex_cn: 开幕式色彩缤纷且热闹。
words.en: An opening ceremony is a formal event that marks the start of a significant occasion, such as the beginning of the Olympic Games, a conference, or a new building.

words.ex: My brother walked at the graduation ceremony last week.
words.ex_cn: 我哥哥上周参加了毕业典礼。
words.en: A graduation ceremony is an event where students receive their academic degrees or diplomas.

words.tr: phrase. 闭幕仪式的开始；典礼结束与开幕的结合描述（通常指毕业典礼等正式活动的起始环节）
words.ex: The close ceremony commencement was marked by a final fireworks display.
words.ex_cn: 闭幕仪式的开始以一场最终的烟花表演为标志。
words.en: A formal event marking the end of an academic program or a significant occasion.

words.tr: n. 入会；入学 ；登记；注册；加入人数
words.ex: His enrollment in the club was approved last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周被批准加入该俱乐部。
words.en: The act of officially joining a course, school, etc., or the number of people who do this.

words.tr:
v. 注册；登记；
n. 登记簿；
words.ex: He will register for the course next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会注册这门课程。
words.en: If you register something, you officially record it or list it.

words.ex: He completed the registration for the course.
words.ex_cn: 他完成了这门课程的登记。
words.en: Registration is the act of officially recording something, especially in an official list or record.

words.ex: Please complete the check-in at the front desk.
words.ex_cn: 请在前台完成签到。
words.en: The act of reporting one's presence, especially at a hotel or an airport, or the place where this happens.

words.ex: He filled out the application form yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天填了申请表。
words.en: A document used to apply for something, such as a job or membership, by providing personal information and details.

words.ex: He asked his teacher for a letter of recommendation.
words.ex_cn: 他请老师写一封推荐信。
words.en: A letter of recommendation is a letter in which the writer describes the qualities, skills, and achievements of a person they know well, with the purpose of supporting that person's application for a job, admission to a school, or other opportunities.

words.tr: phrase. 录取通知书；接受函
words.ex: He received a letter of acceptance from the university.
words.ex_cn: 他收到了大学的录取信。
words.en: A letter of acceptance is a formal letter sent by an educational institution to a candidate, offering them a place in a course or program.

words.ex: The international student lives in the dormitory.
words.ex_cn: 这位国际学生住在宿舍里。
words.en: A student from a country other than the one in which they are studying.

words.tr: phrase. 海外留学生；来自国外的学生
words.ex: The overseas student lives in a dormitory.
words.ex_cn: 这名海外学生住在宿舍里。
words.en: A student who comes from a foreign country to study in another country.

words.tr: phrase. 学期（term泛指学期；semester指一学年中的两个主要学期之一；trimester指一学年分为三个学期中的任一个）
words.ex: He is in the fall term at school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校的秋季学期。
words.en: A division of the academic year, typically lasting several months.

words.ex: The school changed its curriculum last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年学校更改了课程。
words.en: A curriculum is the subjects that are studied in a school, college, or university.

words.ex: The teacher gave her approval for the project.
words.ex_cn: 老师对这个项目表示了赞成。
words.en: If you give your approval to something, you agree with it or allow it to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 入学要求；准入条件
words.ex: The entry requirement for this school is a high school diploma.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校的入学要求是高中文凭。
words.en: The conditions that must be met in order to be admitted into a school, program, or event.

words.tr: phrase. 学术持续时间；指学术课程、学位项目或学习阶段的时间长度
words.ex: The academic durations of most bachelor programs are four years.
words.ex_cn: 大多数本科课程的学术持续时间为四年。
words.en: The period of time during which academic activities are conducted, typically referring to the length of terms or semesters in educational institutions.

words.ex: The tuition for this course is $500.
words.ex_cn: 这门课程的学费是500美元。
words.en: Tuition is the fee charged for instruction, especially at a college, university, or private school.

words.tr:
n. 收费；负责；指控；
v. 收费；充电；
words.ex: The hotel charge is $50 per night.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的收费是每晚50美元。
words.en: If you charge someone, you ask them to pay an amount of money for something that you have sold to them or done for them.

words.ex: The expense of the trip was higher than expected.
words.ex_cn: 这次旅行的费用比预期的要高。
words.en: An expense is the amount of money that you spend on something.

words.ex: He paid the fee to join the club.
words.ex_cn: 他支付了加入俱乐部的费用。
words.en: A fee is a sum of money that you pay to be allowed to do something such as join an organization, or to be given advice or a service.

words.tr: n. 损失；伤亡人数；通行费；
words.ex: The war caused a heavy toll on innocent people.
words.ex_cn: 战争给平民带来了巨大的损失。
words.en: A toll is a small sum of money that you have to pay in order to use a particular bridge or road. / A toll is the total number of deaths, accidents, or disasters that occur in a particular period of time. / When a bell tolls, it rings slowly and repeatedly, often as a sign that someone has died.

words.tr:
n. 车费；费用；
v. 进展；成功（或不成功等）；
words.ex: The bus fare is two dollars.
words.ex_cn: 公交车费是两美元。
words.en: The fare is the amount of money that you pay for a journey that you make, for example, in a bus, train, or taxi.

words.tr: phrase. 课程编号；课程号码
words.ex: The course number is 101.
words.ex_cn: 这门课程的编号是101。
words.en: An alphanumeric code used to identify a specific course or class within an educational institution's curriculum, often for registration purposes.

words.tr: phrase. 模块化课程；由若干独立单元组成的课程
words.ex: He takes a modular course in computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他修了一门模块化的计算机科学课程。
words.en: A modular course is a course of study that is divided into separate units or modules, each of which can be studied independently.

words.tr: phrase. 专业课程；专科课程
words.ex: He took a specialist course in robotics.
words.ex_cn: 他选修了一门机器人专业的课程。
words.en: A course designed to provide in-depth knowledge or training in a specific field or subject.

words.ex: He chose a selective elective in art history.
words.ex_cn: 他选了一门关于艺术史的选修课。
words.en: A medical procedure or treatment that is chosen based on individual patient needs rather than being mandatory.

words.ex: Students can choose optional courses each semester.
words.ex_cn: 学生每学期可以选择选修课。
words.en: Courses that students can choose to take as part of their studies, but are not required to.

words.ex: The software has five different modules.
words.ex_cn: 这个软件有五个不同的模块。
words.en: A module is one of the separate parts of a course of study, especially at a college or university.

words.tr: adj. 必需的；必不可少的； v. 需要；要求；“require”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: Water is required for survival.
words.ex_cn: 水是生存所必需的。
words.en: Necessary according to the rules or for a particular purpose.

words.ex: All students must take compulsory courses in math and science.
words.ex_cn: 所有学生都必须修读数学和科学的必修课程。
words.en: Courses that must be taken by all students as part of their curriculum.

words.ex: He got an exemption from paying the fee.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了免交费用的豁免。
words.en: An exemption is an official permission not to do something or not to pay something that you would normally have to do or pay.

words.tr: phrase. 培训课程；训练课程
words.ex: He joined a training course last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周参加了一个培训课程。
words.en: A training course is a series of lessons or lectures teaching the skills that you need for a particular job or activity.

words.tr: phrase. 预科课程；预备课程
words.ex: He took a preparatory course before starting university.
words.ex_cn: 他在上大学之前参加了一个预备课程。
words.en: A preparatory course is a course that prepares students for a particular exam or course of study.

words.tr:
adj. 专业的；职业的；
n. 专业人士；
words.ex: He is a professional teacher with many years of experience.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有多年经验的专业教师。
words.en: A professional is a person who has a job that requires special training and education, especially one that involves a high level of skill or knowledge.

words.ex: He is learning vocational skills to become a mechanic.
words.ex_cn: 他正在学习职业技能以成为一名机械师。
words.en: Relating to the skills you need to do a particular job.

words.tr: phrase. 双主修（指在大学同时修读两个专业）
words.ex: He is doing a dual major in biology and chemistry.
words.ex_cn: 他主修生物学和化学双专业。
words.en: A dual major is a program of study that allows a student to specialize in two different academic disciplines simultaneously.

words.tr:
adj. 主要的；
n. 大调；主修课；
words.ex: Math is a major subject in school.
words.ex_cn: 数学是学校里的主要科目。
words.en: A major is a student's principal field of study or specialization in college or university.

words.tr:
adj. 次要的；轻微的；小的；小调的；
n. 未成年人；
words.ex: The mistake was a minor error.
words.ex_cn: 这个错误是一个小错误。
words.en: A minor is a person who is under the age at which they legally become an adult.

words.ex: The school changed the course arrangement for next semester.
words.ex_cn: 学校更改了下学期的课程安排。
words.en: The organization and scheduling of courses within an educational program.

words.tr: n. 时间表；时刻表；课程表；
words.ex: The school publishes a new timetable every term.
words.ex_cn: 学校每学期都会公布新的时间表。
words.en: A timetable is a detailed plan showing the times at which things are intended to happen, especially the times at which particular events or activities are planned to occur.

words.ex: He checks the course schedule every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周都查看课程表。
words.en: A timetable showing the times at which particular events or activities are planned to happen, especially in the context of educational courses.

words.ex: The teacher gave us the course outline on the first day.
words.ex_cn: 老师在第一天给了我们课程大纲。
words.en: A course outline is a document that summarizes the main points of a course, including the objectives, content, and assessment methods.

words.tr: phrase. 课程重点；学习的核心内容
words.ex: The course focus is on basic math skills.
words.ex_cn: 这门课程的重点是基本数学技能。
words.en: The main theme, topic, or area of study that a particular course concentrates on, defining its core content and learning objectives.

words.ex: The teacher uses simple teaching material for the students.
words.ex_cn: 老师为学生使用简单的教学材料。
words.en: Materials used by a teacher to facilitate learning, including textbooks, workbooks, and digital resources.

words.tr: phrase. 教学方法；教学途径
words.ex: His teaching approach is simple and clear.
words.ex_cn: 他的教学方法简单而清晰。
words.en: A teaching approach refers to the method or strategy that a teacher uses to deliver content to students, aiming to facilitate learning and understanding.

words.tr:
n. 主题；学科；对象；
v. 使臣服；
adj. 易遭受…的；受…支配的；
words.ex: The subject of the book is ancient history.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的主题是古代历史。
words.en: A subject is something that is discussed, studied, or written about. It can also refer to a person or thing that is the focus of attention or action. In grammar, a subject is the part of a sentence that performs the action of the verb.

words.ex: He majored in arts at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学主修人文学科。
words.en: The arts are activities such as music, painting, literature, film, and dance, which people can take part in for enjoyment, or to create works which express important meanings or ideas.

words.ex: He likes studying humanities in school.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在学校学习人文学科。
words.en: The humanities are academic disciplines that study aspects of human society and culture. In the Renaissance, the term contrasted with divinity and referred to what is now called classics, the main area of secular study in universities at the time. Today, the humanities are more frequently contrasted with natural, and sometimes social, sciences as well as professional training.

words.tr: phrase. 社会科学；社会科学学科
words.ex: He studies social science at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学学习社会科学。
words.en: Social science is the study of society and the relationships among individuals within a society.

words.ex: He likes sciences like biology and chemistry.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢生物和化学等科学。
words.en: The systematic study of the structure and behavior of the physical and natural world through observation and experiment.

words.tr: phrase. 工程课程；工科课程
words.ex: He is taking an engineering course this semester.
words.ex_cn: 他这学期正在上一门工程课程。
words.en: An academic program or class that focuses on the principles, theories, and applications of designing, building, and maintaining structures, machines, and systems.

words.tr: phrase. 医学课程；医疗课程
words.ex: He is taking a medical course at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学修读医学课程。
words.en: A series of classes or a program of study in the field of medicine, aimed at educating students about the human body, diseases, and their treatments.

words.ex: He is learning agronomy at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学学习农学。
words.en: Agronomy is the science of soil management and crop production.

words.ex: He likes natural science because it teaches about animals and plants.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢自然科学，因为它教关于动物和植物的知识。
words.en: Natural science is a branch of science that deals with the physical world, including physics, chemistry, biology, and earth science.

words.tr: phrase. 自然科学；物理科学（指研究非生命系统的科学，如物理、化学、天文学等）
words.ex: He loves physical science because it explains how nature works.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢自然科学，因为它解释了自然如何运作。
words.en: Physical science is a branch of natural science that studies non-living systems, in contrast to life science. It in turn has many branches, each referred to as a 'physical science', together called the 'physical sciences'.

words.ex: He is interested in politics.
words.ex_cn: 他对政治感兴趣。
words.en: Politics are the actions or activities concerned with achieving and using power in a country or society. The verb that follows politics may be either singular or plural.

words.ex: He majors in economics at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学主修经济学。
words.en: Economics is the study of the way in which money, industry, and trade are organized in a society.

words.ex: He is taking sociology at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学里学习社会学。
words.en: Sociology is the study of society, patterns of social relationships, social interaction, and culture that surrounds everyday life.

words.ex: He is studying anthropology at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学里学习人类学。
words.en: Anthropology is the study of human societies and cultures and their development.

words.ex: He wrote a book about ethnography of the tribe.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一本关于这个部落的人种学的书。
words.en: Ethnography is the systematic study of people and cultures. It is designed to explore cultural phenomena where the researcher observes society from the point of view of the subject of the study.

words.ex: He loves reading English literature.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢阅读英语文学。
words.en: Literature consists of written works, especially those considered to have artistic or intellectual value.

words.ex: He broke the law and was arrested.
words.ex_cn: 他违反了法律，被逮捕了。
words.en: A law is a rule or set of rules for good behaviour which is considered right and important by the majority of people for moral, religious, or emotional reasons.

words.ex: He likes to study philosophy in his free time.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在空闲时间学习哲学。
words.en: Philosophy is the study or creation of theories about basic things such as the nature of existence, knowledge, and thought, or about how people should live.

words.ex: He likes to read history books about ancient Rome.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢阅读关于古罗马的历史书籍。
words.en: History is the study of past events, particularly in human affairs.

words.ex: He loves archaeology and digs old artifacts.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱考古学，挖掘古代文物。
words.en: Archaeology is the study of the societies and peoples of the past by examining the remains of their buildings, tools, and other objects.

words.tr:
n. 金融；财务；
v. 提供资金；
words.ex: He works in finance in New York.
words.ex_cn: 他在纽约从事金融工作。
words.en: Finance is the management of large amounts of money, especially by governments or large companies.

words.ex: He is studying linguistics at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学学习语言学。
words.en: Linguistics is the scientific study of language and its structure, including the study of morphology, syntax, phonetics, and semantics.

words.ex: He values education very much.
words.ex_cn: 他非常重视教育。
words.en: Education is the process of teaching and learning, especially in a school or college, or the knowledge that you get from this.

words.ex: He runs a small business selling bread.
words.ex_cn: 他经营一家卖面包的小生意。
words.en: Business refers to the activity of buying and selling goods and services, or a particular company that does this.

words.tr: n. 银行业；银行业务； v. “bank”的现在分词；
words.ex: He works in banking in New York.
words.ex_cn: 他在纽约从事银行业。
words.en: Banking refers to the business activity of accepting and safeguarding money owned by other individuals and entities, and then lending out this money in order to earn a profit.

words.tr: phrase. 酒店接待管理；酒店服务管理，指对酒店运营、客户服务及住宿体验等方面的综合管理
words.ex: He is learning hotel hospitality management at a vocational school.
words.ex_cn: 他在职业学校学习酒店 Hospitality 管理。
words.en: The academic study of managing hotels, resorts, and other lodging facilities, including operations and guest services.

words.tr: n. 年代学；年表；按年代次序的排列
words.ex: He wrote the chronology of ancient Rome.
words.ex_cn: 他写了古罗马的年代顺序。
words.en: Chronology is the arrangement of events or dates in the order of their occurrence.

words.tr: phrase. 全球营销；在全球范围内进行的市场营销活动
words.ex: The company uses global marketing to sell products worldwide.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司使用全球营销来向全世界销售产品。
words.en: Global marketing refers to the strategies and actions undertaken by companies to promote their products or services on an international scale.

words.ex: He loves mathematics because it is logical.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢数学，因为它有逻辑性。
words.en: Mathematics is the study of numbers, shapes, and patterns using reason and usually a special system of symbols and rules for organizing them.

words.ex: He likes maths because it is easy.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢数学，因为它很简单。
words.en: the science of numbers, quantities, and shapes and the relationships between them

words.ex: The statistics show a rise in sales last year.
words.ex_cn: 这些统计数字显示去年销售额有所上升。
words.en: Statistics is a branch of mathematics dealing with the collection, analysis, interpretation, presentation, and organization of data.

words.tr: v. 解释说明；“account”的现在分词； n. 会计；会计学；
words.ex: He is accounting for his absence.
words.ex_cn: 他正在解释他的缺席。
words.en: Accounting is the process of keeping financial accounts.

words.ex: He likes to study physics in school.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在学校学习物理。
words.en: Physics is the scientific study of matter, energy, force, and motion, and how they relate to each other.

words.ex: He likes chemistry because it is fun.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢化学，因为它很有趣。
words.en: Chemistry is the scientific study of the structure of substances and how they react with each other.

words.ex: He likes biology because it teaches about animals and plants.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢生物学，因为它教关于动物和植物的知识。
words.en: Biology is the science which is concerned with the study of living things.

words.ex: He loves studying botany in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在花园里学习植物学。
words.en: Botany is the scientific study of plants.

words.ex: He is learning biochemistry at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学学习生物化学。
words.en: The branch of science concerned with the chemical processes occurring within living organisms.

words.ex: He studies ecology to understand how animals live with plants.
words.ex_cn: 他学习生态学以了解动物如何与植物共存。
words.en: Ecology is the study of the relationships between living organisms, including humans, and their physical environment; it seeks to understand the vital connections between plants and animals and the world around them.

words.ex: He is learning genetics in biology class.
words.ex_cn: 他在生物课上学习遗传学。
words.en: Genetics is the study of how characteristics are passed from one generation to another through genes.

words.ex: He loves watching stars and learning astronomy.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢看星星并学习天文学。
words.en: Astronomy is the scientific study of celestial objects, space, and the physical universe as a whole.

words.ex: He is learning planetology to understand other worlds.
words.ex_cn: 他正在学习行星学以了解其他星球。
words.en: Planetology is the scientific study of planets, moons, and planetary systems, including their formation, evolution, and composition.

words.ex: He loves geography and learns about countries and rivers.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢地理学，学习各国和河流的知识。
words.en: The study of the physical features of the earth and its atmosphere, and of human activity as it affects and is affected by these, including the distribution of populations and resources, land use, and industries.

words.ex: He loves studying geology in high school.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在高中学习地质学。
words.en: The science which deals with the physical structure and substance of the earth, their history, and the processes which act on them.

words.tr: phrase. 海洋学；thalassography 的同义词，研究海洋的物理、化学、生物和地质等特性的科学
words.ex: He studies oceanography to understand sea currents.
words.ex_cn: 他学习海洋学以了解海流。
words.en: The scientific study of the ocean, encompassing its physical, chemical, and biological aspects.

words.ex: He fixed the broken electronics with a small tool.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个小工具修好了坏掉的电子器件。
words.en: The branch of physics and technology concerned with the design of circuits using transistors and microchips, and with the behavior and movement of electrons in a semiconductor, conductor, vacuum, or gas.

words.ex: He wants to study psychology at university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学学习心理学。
words.en: Psychology is the scientific study of the human mind and the reasons for people's behaviour.

words.ex: He is studying electronic engineering at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学学习电子工程。
words.en: Electronic engineering is a branch of engineering that deals with the study and application of electricity, electronics, and electromagnetism.

words.tr: phrase. 机械工程；机械工程学
words.ex: He is studying mechanical engineering at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学学习机械工程。
words.en: Mechanical engineering is a discipline of engineering that applies the principles of physics and materials science for analysis, design, manufacturing, and maintenance of mechanical systems.

words.ex: He is studying chemical engineering at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学学习化学工程。
words.en: Chemical engineering is a branch of engineering that applies physical sciences (e.g., chemistry and physics) and life sciences (e.g., biology, microbiology, and biochemistry) together with mathematics and economics to produce, transform, transport, and properly use chemicals, materials, and energy.

words.ex: He is studying civil engineering at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学学习土木工程。
words.en: Civil engineering is the profession of designing and executing structural works that serve the general public, such as dams, bridges, aqueducts, canals, highways, power plants, sewerage systems, and other infrastructure.

words.ex: He loves computer science and writes code every day.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱计算机科学，每天都写代码。
words.en: Computer science is the study of computers and computational systems. Unlike electrical and computer engineers, computer scientists deal mostly with software and software systems; this includes their theory, design, development, and application.

words.ex: He studies architecture at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学学习建筑学。
words.en: Architecture is the art and science of designing buildings and other physical structures.

words.ex: He studies architectonics to understand building structures.
words.ex_cn: 他学习建筑学以理解建筑结构。
words.en: The science of architecture or the art of structuring or designing.

words.ex: Farmers use irrigation to water their crops.
words.ex_cn: 农民使用灌溉来浇灌庄稼。
words.en: Irrigation is the process of supplying water to land or crops to help growth, typically by means of channels.

words.tr: n. 运作方式；力学；“mechanic”的复数；
words.ex: The mechanics of this machine are simple to understand.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器的运作方式很简单易懂。
words.en: Mechanics is the branch of physics that deals with the action of forces on bodies and with motion, comprised of kinetics, statics, and kinematics.

words.tr: phrase. 通信工程；通讯工程（研究和应用通信系统设计、开发和维护的工程领域）
words.ex: He is studying communication engineering at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学学习通信工程。
words.en: Communication engineering is a field of study that focuses on the transmission of information across channels such as a coax cable, optical fiber or free space.

words.tr: phrase. 环境工程；研究和应用工程原理以改善和维护自然环境，以保护人类健康和生态系统的学科
words.ex: He works in environmental engineering.
words.ex_cn: 他从事环境工程工作。
words.en: Environmental engineering is the branch of engineering that focuses on protecting the environment by reducing waste and pollution.

words.tr:
n. 设计；图案；花样；企图；图谋；
v. 设计；计划；谋划；构思；
words.ex: The dress has a beautiful design.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子有一个美丽的设计。
words.en: To design something means to plan and make a detailed drawing of it, or to plan and create something in a skillful or artistic way.

words.ex: He wants to study engineering at university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学学习工程。
words.en: Engineering is the work involved in designing and constructing engines and machinery, or structures such as roads and bridges. Engineering is also the subject studied by people who want to do this work.

words.ex: He needs surgery for his broken arm.
words.ex_cn: 他需要做手术来治疗断掉的胳膊。
words.en: Surgery is the medical specialty that uses operative manual and instrumental techniques on a patient to investigate or treat a pathological condition such as a disease or injury, to help improve bodily function or appearance, or to repair unwanted ruptured areas.

words.ex: He wants to study medicine at university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学学习医学。
words.en: Medicine is the science or practice of the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of disease.

words.ex: He works in paediatrics at the children's hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他在儿童医院从事儿科工作。
words.en: The branch of medicine dealing with the medical care of infants, children, and adolescents.

words.tr: n. 护理（工作）；护理行业； v. “nurse”的现在分词；
words.ex: She works in nursing at the local hospital.
words.ex_cn: 她在当地医院从事护理工作。
words.en: The profession or practice of providing care for the sick and infirm.

words.ex: He studies physiology to understand how the human body works.
words.ex_cn: 他学习生理学以了解人体如何运作。
words.en: The branch of biology that deals with the normal functions of living organisms and their parts.

words.ex: He works at a small pharmacy near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他在公园附近的一家小药房工作。
words.en: A pharmacy is a shop or a department in a shop where medicines are prepared and sold.

words.ex: Farmers work hard in agriculture.
words.ex_cn: 农民在农业中辛勤工作。
words.en: The science or practice of farming, including cultivation of the soil for the growing of crops and the rearing of animals to provide food, wool, and other products.

words.ex: He works in horticulture at a local garden.
words.ex_cn: 他在当地的一个花园从事园艺工作。
words.en: Horticulture is the study and practice of growing and cultivating plants, especially flowers, fruits, and vegetables.

words.ex: He majored in forestry at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学主修森林学。
words.en: The science or practice of planting, managing, and caring for forests.

words.tr: n. 农事；耕作；养殖； v. 务农；“farm”的现在分词；
words.ex: Farming is hard work in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 农事在乡村是很辛苦的工作。
words.en: Farming is the activity of growing crops or keeping animals on a farm.

words.ex: He runs an aquaculture farm that grows fish.
words.ex_cn: 他经营一个养鱼的水产养殖场。
words.en: Aquaculture is the cultivation of aquatic organisms such as fish, crustaceans, mollusks, and aquatic plants under controlled conditions.

words.tr: phrase. 课程难度等级；课程水平
words.ex: The level of courses at this school is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校课程的水平非常高。
words.en: The difficulty or academic standing of a set of classes or subjects in an educational program.

words.ex: He does intensive reading every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上进行精读。
words.en: Intensive reading refers to the thorough and detailed reading of texts, often with the aim of understanding and analyzing their content deeply.

words.ex: He does extensive reading every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上进行大量阅读。
words.en: Extensive reading refers to reading in quantity and in variety, focusing on the general understanding of texts rather than detailed analysis.

words.tr: adj. 引导的；介绍的；开端的；
words.ex: This is an introductory book for beginners.
words.ex_cn: 这是一本为初学者引导的书。
words.en: An introductory remark, event, or action is one that comes at the beginning of something, often in order to explain or introduce it.

words.ex: He is a beginner in piano lessons.
words.ex_cn: 他是钢琴课的初学者。
words.en: A beginner is someone who has just started learning to do something and has not yet mastered it.

words.tr: adj. 首要的；小学的；初等的；原来的；最初的；
words.ex: Primary goal is to stay safe.
words.ex_cn: 首要目标是保持安全。
words.en: Something that is primary is more important than anything else.

words.tr: adj. 基本的；基础的；根本的；
words.ex: Water is a fundamental need for life.
words.ex_cn: 水是生命的基本需求。
words.en: You use fundamental to describe things, activities, and principles that are very important or essential. They affect the basic nature of other things or are the most important element upon which other things depend.

words.ex: He is learning elementary math at school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校学习初级数学。
words.en: Elementary means relating to the simplest and most basic aspects of a subject.

words.ex: He is an intermediate student in English.
words.ex_cn: 他是英语的中级学生。
words.en: An intermediate stage, level, or position is one that occurs between two other stages, levels, or positions.

words.tr: adj. 中等的；次要的；第二的；
words.ex: He attends a secondary school in the city.
words.ex_cn: 他在城里上一所中学。
words.en: If you describe something as secondary, you mean that it is less important than something else.

words.tr: adj. 先进的；高级的； v. 提前；前进；“advance”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: This school uses advanced technology in classrooms.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校在教室里使用先进的技术。
words.en: An advanced system, method, or design is modern and has been developed from an earlier version of the same thing.

words.tr:
n. 专家；行家；
adj. 内行的；老练的；专门的；
words.ex: He is an expert in computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他是计算机科学方面的专家。
words.en: A person who is very knowledgeable about or skillful in a particular area.

words.tr: adj. 全部时间的；专任的
words.ex: He works full-time at a grocery store.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家杂货店全职工作。
words.en: If you are a full-time worker, you work the normal number of hours or days in a week.

words.tr: phrase. 兼职学生；非全日制学生
words.ex: He is a part-time student who works in the evening.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名兼职学生，晚上工作。
words.en: A part-time student is someone who is enrolled in a course of study but does not attend classes full-time, often because they are working or have other commitments.

words.ex: Please pay in advance.
words.ex_cn: 请提前付款。
words.en: Before a particular time, or before doing a particular thing.

words.tr: n. 毕业文凭；学位证书；
words.ex: He received his diploma last June.
words.ex_cn: 他去年六月拿到了毕业文凭。
words.en: A diploma is a document which may be awarded by a university or college, or by a high school, showing that someone has successfully completed a course of study.

words.ex: The temperature is 30 degrees today.
words.ex_cn: 今天气温是30度。
words.en: A degree is a unit of measurement for angles, or a qualification given to a student by a college or university after they have completed a course of study.

words.ex: He received a certificate for completing the course.
words.ex_cn: 他完成了课程后获得了证书。
words.en: A certificate is an official document attesting a fact, in particular.

words.ex: He is an undergraduate at Harvard.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的一名本科生。
words.en: An undergraduate is a student at a university or college who is studying for their first degree.

words.ex: He earned a bachelor in computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了计算机科学学士学位。
words.en: A bachelor is a man who has never been married.

words.tr:
n. 大学毕业生；
v. 毕业；
words.ex: He is a graduate of Harvard University.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的毕业生。
words.en: A graduate is a person who has successfully completed a degree at a university or college and has received a certificate or diploma stating this. To graduate means to successfully complete a degree at a university or college.

words.tr:
n. 研究生；
adj. 大学毕业后的；
words.ex: He is a postgraduate at Beijing University.
words.ex_cn: 他是北京大学的一名研究生。
words.en: A postgraduate is a student who continues studying after obtaining a first degree, usually in order to obtain a higher qualification.

words.tr: phrase. 文学硕士（通常缩写为M.A.或A.M.）
words.ex: He earned a master of arts in history.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了历史学文学硕士学位。
words.en: A Master of Arts (MA) is a postgraduate academic degree awarded by universities in many countries. The degree is usually studied for in fine art, humanities, social science or theology and can be either fully-taught, research-based, or a combination of the two.

words.ex: The doctor helped the sick child.
words.ex_cn: 医生帮助了生病的孩子。
words.en: A doctor is someone who is qualified in medicine and treats people who are ill.

words.ex: He is doing a post-doctor at Harvard University.
words.ex_cn: 他正在哈佛大学做博士后。
words.en: A post-doctor is a person engaged in advanced research after obtaining a doctoral degree.

words.ex: The children play at Nursery 796.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在796号托儿所玩耍。
words.en: A nursery is a place where young children are cared for during the day while their parents are at work.

words.ex: He goes to kindergarten every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上上幼儿园。
words.en: A kindergarten is a school or class for young children, usually between the ages of four and six.

words.ex: He completed primary education in his hometown.
words.ex_cn: 他在家乡完成了小学教育。
words.en: Primary education refers to the first stage of formal education, coming after preschool and before secondary education. It is typically provided to children aged between 5 and 11.

words.ex: The pupil writes with a pencil in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个小学生在课堂上用铅笔写字。
words.en: A pupil is a child or young person who is being taught in a school or by a private tutor.

words.tr: phrase. 中等教育；中学教育
words.ex: He finished secondary education last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年完成了中学教育。
words.en: Secondary education refers to the stage of education following primary education and preceding tertiary education. It typically includes middle and high school education, aimed at preparing students for higher education or vocational training.

words.tr: adj. 第三的；高等教育的
words.ex: He works in the tertiary sector as a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他作为一名教师在第三产业工作。
words.en: In the context of an economy, the tertiary sector is the part of the economy that provides services rather than producing goods. In geology, the Tertiary period is a former term for the period of time now called the Paleogene and Neogene periods, which followed the Cretaceous period.

words.tr: phrase. 大学教育；高等教育
words.ex: He wants to finish college education and become a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他想完成大学教育，成为一名老师。
words.en: Education provided by a college or university, typically leading to a degree.

words.tr:
n. 研究所；学院；协会；
v. 建立；制定；
words.ex: He works at a research institute.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家研究所工作。
words.en: An institute is an organization set up to do a particular type of work, especially research or teaching. It can also refer to the act of starting something such as a system or an official process.

words.tr: phrase. 中专; 工艺学校
words.ex: He went to a polytechnic school to learn mechanical skills.
words.ex_cn: 他去了一所中专学习机械技能。
words.en: A polytechnic school is an educational institution offering a wide range of subjects, especially vocational or technical subjects.

words.ex: He is a freshman at university.
words.ex_cn: 他是大学的一名新生。
words.en: A freshman is a student in the first year of high school, college, or university.

words.ex: He is a sophomore at Harvard University.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的二年级学生。
words.en: A sophomore is a student in the second year of college or high school.

words.tr:
adj. （职位或等级）较低的；年幼的；（高中、大学的）三年级学生；
n. 年幼者；
words.ex: He is a junior employee in the company.
words.ex_cn: 他是公司里职位较低的员工。
words.en: A junior person is younger or has a lower position than another person.

words.tr:
adj. 资深的；高级的；年长的；
n. 年长者；大四学生；
words.ex: He is a senior engineer with 20 years of experience.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有20年经验的资深工程师。
words.en: Higher in rank, status, or importance; older in age.

words.ex: He is an alumnus of Harvard University.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的男毕业生。
words.en: An alumnus is a former student of a particular school, college, or university.

words.ex: The school invited its alumni to the annual reunion.
words.ex_cn: 学校邀请了它的校友参加年度聚会。
words.en: Alumni are former students of a particular school, college, or university.

words.ex: He wants to go to graduate school after college.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学毕业后读研究生院。
words.en: A graduate school is a school that awards advanced academic degrees (such as master's and doctoral degrees) with the general requirement that students must have earned a previous undergraduate (bachelor's) degree.

words.ex: He went to a technical school to learn how to fix cars.
words.ex_cn: 他去了一所工业学校学习修车。
words.en: A technical school is an educational institution that specializes in teaching practical skills and knowledge related to specific trades or professions.

words.tr: phrase. 职业学校；技术学校
words.ex: He went to a vocational school to learn car repair.
words.ex_cn: 他去了一所职业学校学习修车。
words.en: A vocational school is an educational institution designed to provide vocational education or technical skills required to perform the tasks of a particular and specific job.

words.ex: He changes his clothes to fit his peer-group.
words.ex_cn: 他改变穿着以融入同龄人群。
words.en: A group of people of the same age, status, or social class, often used as a reference point for behavior.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a math assignment.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我们布置了一份数学作业。
words.en: An assignment is a task or piece of work that you are given to do, especially as part of your job or studies.

words.ex: He finished his coursework last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周完成了他的课程作业。
words.en: Coursework refers to the work that students do during a course of study, which is often assessed as part of their final grade.

words.ex: He finished his homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭前完成了家庭作业。
words.en: Homework is school work that teachers give to pupils to do at home in the evening or at the weekend.

words.ex: He wrote his name on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上写了名字。
words.en: A material made from cellulose pulp, derived mainly from wood, rags, and certain grasses, processed into flexible sheets or rolls by deposit from an aqueous suspension, and used chiefly for writing, printing, drawing, wrapping, and covering walls.

words.ex: His thesis is that exercise improves memory.
words.ex_cn: 他的论点是锻炼能改善记忆力。
words.en: A thesis is a long piece of writing based on your own ideas and research that you do as part of a university degree, especially a higher degree such as a PhD.

words.ex: He wrote his dissertation on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于气候变化的学位论文。
words.en: A dissertation is a long piece of writing on a particular subject, especially one written for a university degree.

words.ex: He wrote an essay about his summer trip.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于他暑假旅行的文章。
words.en: An essay is a short piece of writing on a particular subject.

words.tr:
n. 计划；方案；项目；课题；
v. 投射；预计；
words.ex: He presented his school project to the class.
words.ex_cn: 他向全班展示了他的学校计划。
words.en: A project is a piece of work that is planned or intended, or a large piece of work that is done by a group of people.

words.ex: He did an internship at a hospital last summer.
words.ex_cn: 去年夏天，他在一家医院实习。
words.en: An internship is a period of work experience offered by an organization for a limited period of time. It is typically undertaken by students and graduates looking to gain relevant skills and experience in a particular field.

words.ex: We went on a field trip to the zoo.
words.ex_cn: 我们去动物园进行了实地考察。
words.en: An excursion or journey made by a group of people, especially students, for the purpose of learning or research outside the classroom.

words.tr:
n. 练习；实践；惯常做法；
v. 从事；练习；
words.ex: Daily practice helps you improve your skills.
words.ex_cn: 每天的练习帮助你提高技能。
words.en: Practice is the act of rehearsing a behavior over and over, or engaging in an activity again and again, for the purpose of improving or mastering it, as in the phrase 'practice makes perfect'.

words.ex: The charity helps poor children get food and education.
words.ex_cn: 这个慈善团体帮助贫困儿童获得食物和教育。
words.en: An organization that helps people in need, or the act of giving money, food, or help to those who need it.

words.ex: He gave a short speech at the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上做了一个简短的讲话。
words.en: Speech is the expression of or the ability to express thoughts and feelings by articulate sounds.

words.ex: The professor gave a lecture on history.
words.ex_cn: 教授上了一节历史课。
words.en: A lecture is a talk that someone gives in order to teach people about a particular subject, often at a university or college.

words.ex: He went to a tutorial to understand math better.
words.ex_cn: 他去参加辅导以更好地理解数学。
words.en: A tutorial is a period of teaching and discussion with a tutor, especially in a British university or college.

words.ex: He attended a seminar on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他参加了一个关于气候变化的研讨会。
words.en: A seminar is a meeting where a group of people discuss a problem or topic.

words.tr: phrase. 分析性任务；指需要运用分析能力来完成的作业或指派工作
words.ex: He completed his analytical assignment last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚完成了他的分析性作业。
words.en: A task or piece of work that requires careful examination, interpretation, and evaluation of data or information.

words.tr: phrase. 机械性练习；机械式操练；缺乏创造性的训练
words.ex: He did mechanical exercise to improve his typing speed.
words.ex_cn: 他做机械性练习来提高打字速度。
words.en: A mechanical exercise refers to a physical activity or task that is performed repeatedly in a routine manner, often to improve a specific skill or to maintain physical health.

words.tr: phrase. 虚拟学习；指通过互联网或数字技术进行的在线教育或远程学习
words.ex: He attends virtual learning classes at home.
words.ex_cn: 他在家参加在线学习课程。
words.en: Virtual learning refers to an environment where students study a curriculum taught by a teacher in a different location, using the internet and other digital tools.

words.tr: phrase. 理论研究；指基于理论框架而非实验或实践的学术探究
words.ex: He does theoretical study about how stars move.
words.ex_cn: 他进行关于恒星如何运动的理论研究。
words.en: Theoretical study refers to the examination of a subject or problem in order to understand its principles and to develop theories about it, rather than focusing on practical applications.

words.ex: He gave a presentation about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一个关于气候变化的报告。
words.en: The act of showing or explaining something to an audience.

words.tr:
n. 实验；试验；
v. 做试验；进行实验；
words.ex: The boy did a science experiment in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩在课堂上做了一个科学实验。
words.en: An experiment is a scientific procedure undertaken to make a discovery, test a hypothesis, or demonstrate a known fact.

words.ex: The exploration of space takes many years.
words.ex_cn: 太空探索需要很多年。
words.en: The act of searching for the purpose of discovery of information or resources.

words.ex: This factory specializes in making electric cars.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂专用于制造电动汽车。
words.en: If you specialize in a particular subject or skill, you become an expert in it by focusing your studies or work on it.

words.ex: The team improved its defense in the second half.
words.ex_cn: 球队在下半场改进了防守。
words.en: The act of defending against attack, danger, or injury.

words.ex: The company got a lot of publicity from the TV ad.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司从电视广告中获得了大量宣传。
words.en: Publicity is the activity of making sure that someone or something attracts a lot of interest or attention from the public, especially by providing information about them in newspapers, on television, etc.

words.ex: He gave a simple explanation for his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他为自己的错误给出了一个简单的解释。
words.en: An explanation is a statement or account that makes something clear or provides a reason for something.

words.ex: They had a group discussion about homework.
words.ex_cn: 他们就作业进行了一次小组讨论。
words.en: A group discussion is a conversation among a group of people on a specific topic, where everyone is encouraged to contribute their ideas and opinions.

words.tr: n. 举办地点；（比赛）地点；会场；
words.ex: The concert will be held at a new venue.
words.ex_cn: 这场音乐会将在一个新的举办地点举行。
words.en: A place where an event or meeting is held, such as a concert hall or conference center.

words.ex: He reads a science journal every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周读一本科学期刊。
words.en: A journal is a newspaper or magazine that deals with a particular subject or professional activity.

words.tr: phrase. PowerPoint幻灯片；演示文稿中的单页画面
words.ex: He showed a PowerPoint slide about animals.
words.ex_cn: 他展示了一张关于动物的PowerPoint幻灯片。
words.en: A single page or screen in a presentation created using Microsoft PowerPoint software.

words.ex: The layout of the room makes it feel bigger.
words.ex_cn: 房间的布局让它显得更大。
words.en: The way in which the parts of something are arranged or laid out.

words.tr:
n. 结构；建筑物；
v. 组织；
words.ex: The structure of the bridge is very strong.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥的结构非常坚固。
words.en: The arrangement of and relations between the parts or elements of something complex.

words.ex: The teacher gave us the syllabus for the course.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们这门课的教学大纲。
words.en: A syllabus is an outline or summary of the main points of a text, lecture, or course of study.

words.tr: n. 受公众注意的程度；简介；轮廓；
words.ex: The celebrity's profile rose after the TV interview.
words.ex_cn: 这位名人经过电视采访后，受公众注意的程度提高了。
words.en: A profile is a side view of something, especially a person's face, or a brief description of someone or something.

words.ex: He gave a summary of the story at the end.
words.ex_cn: 他在结尾对故事做了总结。
words.en: A summary is a brief statement or account of the main points of something.

words.tr:
adj. 抽象的；非具体的；
n. 摘要；概要；抽象派艺术作品；
words.ex: The painting shows an abstract shape.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画展示了一个抽象的形状。
words.en: An abstract idea or way of thinking is based on general ideas rather than on real things and events.

words.ex: This book has five sections.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有五个部分。
words.en: A section of something is one of the parts into which it is divided or from which it is formed.

words.ex: He read the first chapter of the book.
words.ex_cn: 他读了这本书的第一章。
words.en: A chapter is one of the parts that a book is divided into. Each chapter has a number, and sometimes a title.

words.ex: The teacher put emphasis on reading every day.
words.ex_cn: 老师强调每天都要阅读。
words.en: Special importance, value, or prominence given to something.

words.ex: He wrote a draft of the letter before sending it.
words.ex_cn: 他在发送之前写了这封信的草稿。
words.en: A draft is a preliminary version of a piece of writing, or a current of air in a room or other confined space. It can also refer to the act of selecting someone for a particular purpose or task, especially in sports or the military.

words.ex: He revised his answer to make it correct.
words.ex_cn: 他修正了他的答案，使其正确。
words.en: To revise something means to alter or amend it, especially in order to correct or improve it.

words.ex: He made a correction to his answer.
words.ex_cn: 他改正了他的答案。
words.en: A correction is a change that makes something right, accurate, or better.

words.ex: He is doing proofreading for his essay.
words.ex_cn: 他正在为他的文章做校对。
words.en: Proofreading is the activity of finding and correcting mistakes in text before it is printed or put online.

words.ex: He will submit his homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会提交他的作业。
words.en: To yield or surrender (oneself) to the will or authority of another.

words.ex: The length of the table is two meters.
words.ex_cn: 桌子的长度是两米。
words.en: The measurement or extent of something from end to end; the greater of two or the greatest of three dimensions of a body.

words.ex: He finished his homework before the deadline.
words.ex_cn: 他在截止日期前完成了作业。
words.en: A deadline is a time or date before which a particular task must be finished or a particular thing must be done.

words.ex: She is flexible with her schedule.
words.ex_cn: 她的日程安排很灵活。
words.en: Able to change or be changed easily according to the situation.

words.tr: n. 扩展；延长期；延伸；电话分机；
words.ex: The company added an extension to its office building.
words.ex_cn: 公司为办公楼加了一个扩建部分。
words.en: An extension is a part that is added to something to make it longer or larger, or the act of adding this part.

words.ex: He word-processed his report last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚用文字处理软件打了他的报告。
words.en: Having been processed by a word processor.

words.ex: He is learning English grammar every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都在学习英语语法。
words.en: Grammar is the system and structure of a language. The rules of grammar help us decide the order we put words in and which form of a word to use.
